title: DefenseCon 2956 FAQ
summary: Drake is back and running DefenseCon 2956 bigger, bolder, and more bodacious than ever! Here's a few things that'll help navigate the expo. What is DefenseCon? When the UEE pulled Invictus back to Sol, DefenseCon didn’t wait for orders, it stepped up. That’s right, bigger, bolder, and more bodacious than ever, the ultimate expo is here and loaded with the manufacturers you trust. Set your own rules, find your edge, and defend your little corner of the black, no matter what’s thrown at you.  When is DefenseCon? DefenseCon runs May 14 through May 27. Mark it.  What time does the event start? DefenseCon starts at 1600 UTC.  Where does DefenseCon take place? The Bevic Convention Center on Area18, ArcCorp.  How do I get to the Bevic Convention Center? Head to ArcCorp. New to the 'verse? Spawn directly at the habitation building in Area18 and you're already close. Veterans, jump to ArcCorp, spline to Area18, and put down at Riker Memorial Spaceport. Follow the signs to the Bevic Convention Center from there. I am a new player. Where do I get more info? Nobody's born knowing how to fly. The New Player Guide gets you up to speed, and the Welcome Hub has the tutorials to keep you from hurting yourself out there. If you'd rather learn from someone who's actually been shot at, the Guide System hooks you up with veterans who know the 'verse the hard way. Still got questions? The Knowledge Base covers the basics so you can stop asking and start flying.  I don’t have a Star Citizen Game Package or a spacecraft. How can I get to DefenseCon? Don't have a package or a ship? No problem. DefenseCon is a free fly event, open to everyone. All free fly accounts come loaded with an RSI Aurora Mk II loaner ship to get you to ArcCorp, and once you're there, take some fancy military hardware for a spin and see what the 'verse has to offer. No commitment required.  When does the Freefly start?  The FreeFly is live and will run through May 27.   How do I rent a ship? See something you want to get your hands on? Hit the Travelers Rental terminals in the main DefenseCon hall during that ship/vehicle's Manufacturer Day and follow the prompts to rent it. Easy.  What ships are available to fly for free? Different ships rotate in throughout DefenseCon. Check the Comm-Link for the full lineup and schedule.  How long can a ship be rented? Rentals run 48 hours. Make the most of it.  How many ships can be rented? Every flyable and drivable vehicle on the floor is fair game. Each one can be rented once, so choose wisely.  Can I invite a friend? Bring everyone. All they need is a free account on the Play Now page, and they're in. Have them use your referral code at signup and when they buy a ship, they'll earn an extra 50,000 UEC and you'll score a referral point. Refer a friend during DefenseCon, and you'll earn a Drake Dragonfly with Coalfire paint, and the player you referred will receive a DefenseCon T-Shirt & Hat, plus cargo pants.  Will there be more Twitch drops? Twitch Drops are back for DefenseCon 2956. Watch any drops enabled Star Citizen stream for four hours between May 14 and May 27 to unlock an exclusive Tailwind ‘Murray Cup’ flight suit and helmet. Just make sure your Twitch and RSI accounts are linked before you tune in so your drops land where they're supposed to. Will there be Daily Warbond deals? Every day of DefenseCon brings a new Warbond Daily Deal, live for 24 hours only. Don't sleep on them. This year's Finale runs May 26 at 1600 UTC through May 27 at 2000 UTC and comes with a fresh wave of Warbond Deals exclusive to that window.  Will there be quantity stock-limited ships? Yes, and they go fast. Each stock-limited ship is capped at one per account and drops in waves to cover time zones across the 'verse. Depending on where you are, Waves may land on the next calendar day. Wave 1 16:00 UTC Wave 2 20:00 UTC Wave 3 00:00 UTC  Wave 4 04:00 UTC Wave 5 08:00 UTC Wave 6 12:00 UTC Starting on May 14: Drake Kraken, Drake Kraken Privateer Starting on May 20: Aegis Idris-P, Aegis Javelin Starting On May 24: Anvil Odin Starting on May 26: Finale  Got more questions? Drop them below.

title: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hey everyone,
body_html:
Hey everyone,

Hope you’re all ready to jump into the upcoming Alpha 4.8 patch! We’ve got some solid VR updates in this patch, including a couple of major improvements. Let’s dive in!

Interaction Prompts Rendered in World Space

This is a big one. Interaction prompts and indicators are now rendered directly in world space and work natively in VR. No more flat-screen overlays fighting against your headset view.

This is the first step in a broader UI rework aimed at making Star Citizen truly VR-native, so expect more improvements as we continue down this path.

FPS Crosshair and Hitmarkers Ported to World Space

The FPS crosshair has also been moved into 3D space and re-enabled for VR.

To make sure it appears correctly, head into the Game Settings and confirm that:

Crosshair Mode is enabled

Crosshair Opacity is set to a visible value

Happy hunting!

Additional Improvements

Procedural Head Recoil Disabled in VR - Procedural head recoil while firing weapons has now been disabled in VR. Shooting should feel much smoother and significantly less nauseating.

Shadow Fix for Split-Eye Rendering - Fixed an issue where shadows could render incorrectly in one eye.

Resolution Maintained Across VR Mode Switches - Resolutions are now properly preserved when toggling VR on or off and when switching into Theater Mode. If you enjoy ultrawide Theater Mode and want to jump back into full VR without reconfiguring settings each time, it should now work seamlessly.

Fixed Bright Light Artifacts - Fixed an issue where bright lights could sometimes appear when being shot at.

What's Coming Next

The marker rework is next on the list, and work will begin on it shortly, followed by hologram fixes.

We’ll continue pushing polish and new VR features moving forward. If you encounter new issues or have suggestions, feel free to reply to this thread. We’ll be reading through everything!

19/05/2026:

- Fixed non visible Salvage UI in Remote Turrets in VR (Tested Reclaimer and Moth)

03/06/2026:

- Fixed all Markers, Tractor and Salvage overlays

14/07/2026: (Star Citizen 4.9)

VR Keybinds like Theater Mode Toggle, Tracking Reset should work now everywhere unless they are explicitly blocked. For example you can use them now during loading and in the frontend which was not possible before.

3D Eva Direction Markers (in fact it was broken even in 2D, so now it should work again)

Screen-fading directly on the backbuffer so it also works in VR

Updated OpenXR from 1.0.50 to 1.1.60

> Implemented XR_EXT_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_VIEWS_CHANGE_EXTENSION_NAME. This means if you use SteamVR and change the resolution in the SteamVR settings it updates now in realtime in the engine!

Stereo Cursor Updates:

> Fix invisible cursor in ships with a radar

> Stereo cursor fully body aligned so it doesn't move anymore with external forces like water or trains, elevator

> Restrict cursor to g_headtracking_hmd_cursorMaxViewAngleDeg (default: 40 Degrees) so it no longer can get lost so easily. If you don't like this behavior just set a very high number for this cvar to restore the old behavior.

In EVA always force EHACM_DirectOffset as it was causing weird rotations otherwise (only relevant if GroundedLook is active)

15/08/2026: (Star Citizen 4.10)

Features

Holographic elements (ship radars, the New Babbage greeter, Area18 holograms, and more) now render correctly in VR.

Introduced a new global fading system, offering greater flexibility and full VR support. Added a fade transition when entering and exiting theater mode, configurable via r_StereoTheaterModeFadeTime.

Implemented XR_EXT_user_presence support for dynamic stereo switching, extending compatibility to any headset supporting this extension, including SteamVR.

Replaced g_headtracking_hmd_fpsResetDistance with g_headtracking_hmd_fpsHeadBoundaryDistance, introducing a new shader-based fade effect in place of the previous hard reset. The effect now begins at 0.4m (up from the previous 0.2m reset threshold) and gradually intensifies. This effect also now triggers by default whenever the camera clips through an object, preventing players from seeing through walls in first person.

The water simulation and underwater shader have been enabled for VR.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where opening kiosks interfered with the player animation system causing unintended player movement.

Resolved a recurring shadow flickering issue where shadows would stop following the camera.

Fixed head tracking incorrectly applying to RTT cameras (e.g., comm calls).

Fixed third-person camera collision in VR when the camera position was adjusted.

VRAM usage in the graphics menu now correctly reflects usage in VR.

Disabled chromatic aberration in VR.

Fixed multi-choice selection in VR (e.g., holo greeter in New Babbage, which is now visible).

Fixed an issue where GForce blink effects were applied independently to each eye instead of in sync.

05/10/2026: (Star Citizen 4.10.2)

New: VR now has its own zoom, which works by narrowing the field of view. This is meant to be a temporary solution for scopes until we have fully physicalized Scopes. It's enabled for:

F Interaction Zooming

ADS / Precision Targeting in ships

FPS weapon scopes

A new Zoom Gameplay Strength option controls how strong the zoom is. Set it lower to reduce the effect, or set it to 0 to turn VR zoom off completely.

Advanced users can use these cvars for a more customized experience:

r_StereoZoomScopeMin (1.0): scopes at or below this magnification don't zoom.

r_StereoZoomHeadTrackingRotationScale (1.0): makes the view turn less than your head while zoomed, to reduce discomfort. 0 turns it off.

r_StereoZoomLockAngle (10): how close (in degrees) your head must point to your aim for the zoom to apply.

r_StereoZoomLockReleaseScale (1.5): extra margin before the zoom releases, so it doesn't flicker.

r_StereoZoomScopeAlignDistance (0.04): how close (in meters) your eye must be to the scope's line of sight.

r_StereoZoomSmoothTime (0.2): how many seconds the zoom takes to ease in and out.

Bug Fixes

Fixed some UI icons disappearing after their spawn animation.

Fixed mouse smoothing and acceleration resetting when switching to VR.

Grounded Look now uses your aim direction for hand mining and similar actions.

In Freelook (Z) when in the ATLS, you can now aim the tractor beam with your head.

See you in the 'verse.

title: [4.8 LIVE Feedback] Ship Balance Changes - Ship weapons, Shields, and Armor Updates
summary: Greetings!  4.8 has introduced various ship balance changes. This includes upwards adjustments to armor deflection of larger ships, including cap ships. Updated the ships sitting between heavy fighters and large ships like the hammerhead to have their own armor balancing (Such as Redeemer and Constellation series). Shield updates to shield components across the board to adjust health, shield resistance, and health regen. This update will see most shields having a health pool reduction around 20% while most shield regen speeds increased. Attrition weapons have also had a balance pass to reduce their damage by a significant amount while increasing heat per second and increasing charge up time.  Additionally, you will see wide pricing updates to ship components, weapons, and munitions. This will see many components get increases to cost while some will have significant reductions in price such as certain fuel tanks, missiles, torps, and more.  A feedback survey is available at: Ship Balance Changes Survey Form. This survey will be open until June 15.  We look forward to reading your feedback!  -Shark Player Experience Team

title: Re: Ironclad/assault
summary: Ciao! The expected damage behaviour when the Command Module is docked to the Ironclad/Caterpillar is as follows: Armour: The Command Module inherits all armour values of the ship to which it is docked. Damage Propagation: When bullets strike the Command Module while docked, the damage is transferred directly to the host ship. This damage remains with the host ship and is not transferred to the Command Module upon undocking. Shields: When docked, the Command Module is covered by the host ship's shields and utilises only the host ship's shield items, never its own. If any of these behaviours are not respected, you may have encountered a bug. In that case, we would appreciate it if you could contribute to an existing Issue Council report or create a new one if needed.  Thanks! Montic - Vehicle Experience Team

title: Alpha 4.8: Vehicle Insurance and Item Bricking Update
summary: Hi everyone,   With the release of Alpha 4.8, we’re introducing several updates to vehicle insurance along with a new item bricking system. Read on for a full overview of what’s changing and what to expect.     High-Level Overview  The current claim system has served us well, but as the universe becomes more persistent (and eventually dynamic), we want vehicle loss and recovery to feel more meaningful. At the same time, you shouldn't feel like the game is working against you when you just want to get back out there.   The updates coming in Alpha 4.8 are designed to strike that balance: adding more depth and consequence to insurance and item recovery, while supporting the long-term vision for Star Citizen’s living economy and persistent universe.     Insured Loadouts  Going forward, your ship will have two distinct loadouts.   The manufacturer loadout is the default configuration of your ship. It cannot be edited and will always be there as your fallback.   The insured loadout is yours. It's the custom configuration you built and want to protect. You can still edit through the Vehicle Loadout Manager in your mobiGlas, but to save your loadout, you’ll need to head to an ASOP terminal. When you save, you'll see a full list of every item being registered under that loadout before you confirm.    In future updates, insured loadouts will also cover items in weapon racks, suit lockers and decorations.   At the launch of Alpha 4.8, any items attached to your ship that you do not imprint will be lost and unrecoverable. Due to a feature limitation, this temporarily includes any vehicle-equipable items or paints acquired through the pledge store, or attributed via the RSI website. We intend to address this next week with a patch update enabling the ability to recover any lost pledge items for vehicles you may have forgotten to imprint, via the freight elevator. This will be followed with a more robust item kiosk offering in July’s 4.9.     Claim Timers & Insurance Claims  We’ve reworked the claim timer system to make recovering your ship feel more natural within a persistent universe, while also reducing downtime in many common situations.   Instead of the timer only starting once you file a claim, it now begins running in the background as soon as your ship is delivered to your hangar. In practice, that means some or even all of the wait may already be completed by the time you actually need to make a claim. The system keeps progressing while you play.   As part of this update, claim expedites have been removed.   When filing a claim, you’ll now choose between two recovery options:   Manufacturer Claim  Longer wait time   No UEC cost   Returns the default manufacturer loadout   Does not restock missiles or bombs    Insured Claim  Shorter wait time   UEC cost based on your ship hull and insured components   Returns your saved custom loadout   Does not restock missiles or bombs    To help support these changes, we’ve also increased payouts for select missions and reduced the cost of vehicle consumables.     Item Bricking  We’re introducing item bricking in Alpha 4.8 as part of our ongoing efforts to address item duplication.   Any item registered as part of your manufacturer or insured loadout is tied to that vehicle. When you file a claim, any previous copies of that ship and its registered components will begin a bricking countdown.   During that countdown, everything will continue functioning normally. Once the timer expires, those items become bricked and can no longer be used.   For 4.8, bricked items and vehicles cannot be sold to shops or dismantled for parts. We’ll continue iterating on this system in future updates.   One important note: bricked vehicles will remain stored in your hangar rather than being removed automatically. This gives you time to recover any cargo or personal items before the vehicle is permanently retired.     Vehicle Storage Adjustments  Local hangars now have a storage limit. Once you hit the cap, you'll need to scrap ships to free up space. Any ship you own that gets scrapped can always be claimed back through your ship catalogue, so nothing is permanently lost.   ---  As always, we’ll be closely monitoring the backend data and keeping a close eye on your feedback.   Have questions? Let us know below and we'll do our best to get answers from the team.

We’ll continue iterating on this system in future updates. One important note: bricked vehicles will remain stored in your hangar rather than being removed automatically. This gives you time to recover any cargo or personal items before the vehicle is permanently retired. Vehicle Storage Adjustments Local hangars now have a storage limit. Once you hit the cap, you'll need to scrap ships to free up space. Any ship you own that gets scrapped can always be claimed back through your ship catalogue, so nothing is permanently lost. --- As always, we’ll be closely monitoring the backend data and keeping a close eye on your feedback. Have questions? Let us know below and we'll do our best to get answers from the team.

title: Tactical Strike Groups - FAQ
summary: "Tactical Strike Group" is our new cooperative ship combat experience, available in Alpha 4.8: "Tactical Strike"! A series of coordinated objectives awaits your team, where every ship and every pilot has a job to do. Bring the right ships, the right weaponry, and a proper plan to keep your pilots repaired and resupplied, from capital ships down to your boots-on-the-ground FPS players. Note that a strong reputation (Rank III+) with Intersec is required to access the mission.  Intersec is looking to you to assemble a small and well-balanced group of citizens to protect the People's Alliance ship Tranquility and their captured pilot from hostile Shattered Blade forces.  Here's what you need to know before you launch. ▲ What are Tactical Strike Groups? A Tactical Strike Group is an Operation, a cooperative mission chain that challenges a group of players to work together across multiple roles: dogfighting, torpedo/missile attacks, FPS combat, logistics, and more.  Success depends on bringing the right mix of ships, loadouts, and the means to keep your team repaired and resupplied on the field throughout the mission in the new location, a QV Extraction Station.  The mission can be shared with other players in your party.   ▲ How do I find a QV Extraction Station? Open your mobiGlas and accept one of the following Mercenary Contracts from Deacon Tobin, Intersec’s contract giver, which will lead you to the QV Extraction Station: :clipboard: Tactical Strike Group Needed - Full multiplayer mission. Bring a large party. :boom: Strategic Attacks - Solo mission focused on surface-to-ground attack ships. :fire: Assist People's Alliance Vessel Tranquility - Solo dogfighting mission for fighter pilots.   ▲ Can I replay this content? Yes, absolutely, Tactical Strike Group missions are fully replayable, allowing you to increase your reputation and earn more rewards!   ▲ What roles does my group need to cover? Plan for around 10 ships and skilled pilots crewing these, and covering these core roles: :sparkles: Dogfighting - Skilled fighters will be needed to repel enemies. :boom: Surface attacks - Torpedoes, missiles, strafing runs... Prepare the proper armament to destroy heavy turrets and key defenses protecting the station. :zap:️ Tight-space maneuvering at higher speeds - Trench run anyone? That's your job: get rid of defenses and station's components to protect your party and give breathing room for your landing troops. :fire: FPS Combat - You'll need a ground team to complete FPS objectives inside the station, and of course a Dropship to land them safely! :beginner: Logistics - Rearm, resupply, heal, and support your pilots. :package: Hauling - Prepare enough cargo grid to move your loot from the station to your favorite stash.   ▲ What rewards can I look forward to? Completing the mission can yield blueprints, flight suits and helmets, high-quality ship components, a unique bomber jacket, rare trade commodities, and of course some good ol' aUEC for your trouble!   ▲ Mission Walkthrough (Spoilers) :one: Defend the Idris An Idris, owned by People's Alliance and piloted by Captain Aniss Martell, is under attack from the Shattered Blade ships beneath the station, out of sight of the Vanduul tech turrets. Work together to eliminate all threats before moving on with your next objectives.  :two: Destroy the power relays Navigate the turret-defended exterior and destroy 6 power relays to open the station's maintenance tunnels. Note that relays are only vulnerable to ballistic damage, so energy weapons won't cut it.  :three: Destroy the cooling units Fighter ships must navigate distortion-filled internal tunnels in multiple runs to destroy 18 cooling units. As units fall, the core overheats (glowing brighter, emitting smoke) until the shield doors and exterior vents open automatically.  :four: Destroy the core and defend the People's Alliance's Idris With the core exposed, destroy 4 internal core stabilizers or attack the core directly from the exterior (It requires significantly more damage, however). Once the core is gone, all Vanduul and security turrets go offline. Simultaneously, the People's Alliance Idris will call for help again under a harder wave of Shattered Blade attackers. Split your forces or concentrate firepower, your call to adapt to the situation at hand.  :five: FPS: free the hostage Deploy your ground team to the now-unlocked landing pad. Fight through Shattered Blade Elites and their boss "Forge" to reach the security room, then use the terminal to open the hangar doors for the People's Alliance hostage ship. The hostage will tip you off about a security card left behind, and hint that one of two cargo decks is locked and worth investigating.  :six: Escort the hostage "Gabe Windell" to safety Protect the People's Alliance hostage ship as it spools up to quantum travel. Vanduul reinforcements arrive in force! If the People's Alliance Idris is still combat-ready, it will assist your team to help in combat against a greater Vanduul foe: a Mauler! Hold on long enough for the hostage to Quantum away: This is your win condition. Of course, don’t forget to loot the station’s rooms and anything you spotted during the operation. Salvage what you can, bring it back, and share the spoils with your party!   ▲ Any last tips? Coordination is everything. Designate roles before you undock: Assign a team to pilot and manage your carrier. Have a logistics team ready to repair/replace/resupply your fighters. Hire expert torpedo boats and missile gunships. Get a solid FPS team and enough supplies to last while in the station. Prepare a fully loaded support ship, keeping your forces repaired and rearmed. You might not succeed at first, but learn from your mistakes and come back fully prepared!   :avocado: Tips from the Evocati A ship capable of rearming and repairing fighters is crucial during TSG. The Idris series, Polaris, and Ironclad Assault currently excel in that role, but ships like the 890 Jump, 600i, Carrack, or Starlancer TAC can also get the job done. - MrTrash Bring an engineer on board to handle fires, repair components, and even provide support fire with a railgun! - Evens Don’t forget your best ally, the People’s Alliance Idris. You can use it to repair, rearm, and refuel when needed. - Le_Roux-nard The Sabre Firebird and Talon Shrike are excellent options for surface attack roles. - Ewentx Avoid staying too long in the tunnels during trench runs. It’s better to make multiple passes than risk getting disabled by distortion building up inside the station. - Farden For trench runs, consider a Size 2+ power plant and running as a duo, so the pilot can focus on maneuvering while the gunner handles the objectives. - Samm Gelfond Medics, remind your party memebers to set their regeneration in your main ship! - Tsuya_Arcanys Communicate with your ally to avoid crashing into each other in the station's tunnels - Narmacil

title: Star Citizen Alpha 4.8 LIVE - Hotfix Central [Updated 7.1]
summary: Hi Everyone!  Time again for another Hotfix Central thread to keep you all up to date on things going on outside of the normal patch cycle in SC Alpha 4.8 LIVE! This will be a living document of all the hotfixes applied to the current LIVE environment, along with dates as a timeline and when the HOTFIX channel is open and closed.  These posts will be locked down to comments as the updates will span the entire 4.8 cycle so please check out the issue council and testing chats for any information you would like to let us know about!  Current 4.8 LIVE Status | 7.1.2026 https://status.robertsspaceindustries.com/ https://robertsspaceindustries.com/en/comm-link/Patch-Notes/21168-Star-Citizen-Alpha-48 https://issue-council.robertsspaceindustries.com/projects/STAR-CITIZEN     Status: Hotfix Channel Currently CLOSED     Latest LIVE Client CL: 12122953     Latest LIVE DGS CL: 12122953 ► 7.1.2026:  Arena Commander Stability SC Alpha 4.8.3 - 12122953 The Arena Commander stability fixes for client and server have been merged into the new LIVE update for 4.8.3. ► 6.19.2026: 12061511 4.8.2 Client/Server Stability and Hotfixes being worked on Client Stability hotfix is now on LIVE. This includes fixes for 3 of the top client crashes Server hotfix has begun rolling out to further servers as they hit server errors. This update includes fixes for 5 of the top server crashes ► 6.12.2026: 4.8.1 Client/Server Potential Hotfix We are currently testing a new Client and Server hotfix with the goal of testing the server side fixes on select shards and opening up the Hotfix Channel later today for over the weekend for the client side. This includes multiple client and server crash fixes along side these noted below. If the server side of the hotfix validates, we will begin rolling it out further.  // Client Side Fixes Command Module - QT Points are invisible after crossing a server boundary While traveling through Jump Tunnels, QT, or general flight the vehicles may switch into SCM GUN mode // Requires both Client / Server Multivehicle - PU - Vehicle / mobiGlas / Service - Ship-to-Ship services absent/not functioning across multiple vehicles PU - Multi-System - Spaceport - Locations / Interactions - Docking / ATC - Unable to Dock using Docking Collars Tailwind Flight Suit - Flight suit causes actor hands and feet to be invisible // Server Side Fixes Ship Battles - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted Potential fix for inventories becoming empty or inaccessible ► 5.28.2026: Service Hotfix A service hotfix went out overnight to fix an issue where some ships cannot be claimed through 'Claim Insured Loadouts'. This affected the Shiv and the Cutlass series. ► 5.21.2026: CL 11875683 - Today's maintenance introduces a new hotfix along with a feature update for implementing individual claim modes for item recovery. Individual Claim Mode Update Today's maintenance build update includes a new feature to item recovery. Freight elevators now have a new "Claim Mode" button on the terminal that will only be accessible at your home location. This new Claim Mode button brings up a window with all platform (website) owned ship items (other than vehicles, consumables, and items in a vehicle's default loadout) and allows you to claim one ship item at a time back to your home location. Claiming an item will add it to the inventory accessed by the kiosk (may require refreshing the window) and brick the previously owned item. For filtering, an "Exclude Paints" checkbox at the top hides all paints from the list for cleaner access.   Multiple Server and Client crash fixes Fixes for Storm Breaker AI not spawning on additional runs Fixes for players clipping through ramps and elevators of vehicles after being refueled Fixes for incorrectly long insurance claim timers Fix for mined ores disappearing after storing a vehicle Additional fixes for TSG locations not cleaning up abandoned vehicles and debris Fix for Ironclad thruster audio Arena Commander fixes for being unable to equip weapons and armor Multiple Client and Server Crash fixes Server: Some vehicles not despawning after being stored and retrieved from the ASOP Server: Multivehicle - PU - Vehicles - If the player calls Landing Services in the hangar when another vehicle is on the pad the other vehicle will be stored Server: Abandoned vehicles are persisting at TSG Locations after the location has been streamed out Server: Fix landing area checking obstruction bounds instead of full bounds when deciding to store a vehicle on the pad Server: Ships without ballistic guns are unable to restock missiles and countermeasures through the landing services inside another ship that provides landing services despite having resources on the cargo grid Server: Multivehicle - PU - Vehicles / Landing Services - Ships without ballistic guns are unable to restock missiles and countermeasures through the landing services inside another ship that provides landing services despite having resources on the cargo grid Client: PU - Loading Screens - Area18 - Server prevents the player actor from moving at all after loading in Client+Server: Fix for ships colliding with each other during auto-undocking execution Client+Server: Ships switch to SCM Master Mode when changing servers Client+Server: Contested Zone airlock access not cycling Service Hotfix: PU - Missions / UI - Mission QT target moving away rapidly through space    Using the HOTFIX channel The HOTFIX channel will become available for periods of time when the client-side of the game needs the hotfix. This channel will point to the LIVE environment and using this will retain and add progress to your LIVE account as if you were playing normally. The best way to play on HOTFIX is to rename your LIVE folder to HOTFIX and verify using the HOTFIX channel on the launcher. Reverse this process to go back to LIVE once it is released or you would like to stop using this channel.

title: Join DefenseCon 2956
summary: Hi everyone,  Get ready, DefenseCon returns bigger & better from May 14 through May 27.  When the UEE pulled Invictus back to Sol, DefenseCon didn’t wait for orders, Drake Interplanetary CEO Anden Arden has seized the moment to throw the galaxy's boldest arms expo in their place. Whether you're a seasoned pilot looking for your next weapon of choice or just someone who believes every citizen deserves the right ship, DefenseCon 2956 has one message for the galaxy: the Navy can keep its formalities, we'll keep the explosions.  Join the celebration at the Bevic Convention Center in Area18, where manufacturers will showcase their fleets and offer free test flights of some of the most iconic and formidable military ships in the ’verse: Throughout the event, you’ll have ongoing opportunities to pilot a diverse selection of cutting-edge spacecraft, all available in one place. Also, be sure to stop by the IO-North Tower as well, where you can take in the sight of the massive Anvil Odin battlecruiser, perfectly positioned for a breathtaking view over Area18.  But there’s more than just ships to fly, as DefenseCon comes with a full lineup of events and festivities. Everyone can take to the skies during the Free Fly event, an exclusive Referral Bonus rewards those who bring new recruits into the 'verse, and Twitch Drops opportunities will be enabled! Enjoy everything DefenseCon 2956 has to offer: DefenseCon 2956 || FAQ Manufacturer Schedule - For the first time ever, Drake takes the helm as it brings all ship manufacturers together for its biggest event ever! Tobii's Everyday Heroes Screenshot Contest - Be a hero and show it to the world, for a chance to earn some of the new ships coming this DefenseCon, including two Tobii Eye Tracker 5! Drake Ironclad and Ironclad Assault || Q&A Drake Pitbull || Q&A Origin M80 || Q&A MISC Starlite || Q&A Aegis Tiburon || Q&A Anvil Odin, concept || Star Citizen Live - DefenseCon Showcase: Odin Battlecruiser Play for FREE during Drake DefenseCon 2956 - The Free Fly will run through May 27. ⁠Referrals - Refer a friend and get your Drake Dragonfly + Coalfire paint! Your recruit will receive a DefenseCon T-Shirt, hat, and cargo pants. Twitch Drops - Head to Twitch/StarCitizen, and tune in to any Drops enabled stream for a total of four hours to unlock the Tailwind ‘Murray Cup’ flight suit and helmet, for free. New Player Guide Welcome Hub, for new players || Welcome Back, for returning pilots

title: Tobii's Everyday Heroes Screenshot Contest
summary: Forget the Navy's polished ceremonies. Drake built DefenseCon 2956 for one reason: to celebrate the people the UEE forgot. The haulers, the medics, the everyday heroes holding the 'verse together. The real ones. No rank required. Just show up.  We want to celebrate those hardworking folks who keep it all humming. Did you answer a beacon and revive a downed Citizen in need? Had a friendly hauler come to your rescue when you were stranded on a distant moon? Or maybe you showed a new pilot the ropes and helped load their cargo. If a player did anything cool that made someone else's day, that counts!  Whatever it is, if it made a difference, no matter how small, we want to see it. For every person who either did someone a solid or wants to honor those who did, this is your moment. This is your contest. How To Participate We’re calling on the community to celebrate "Everyday Heroes" who make the 'verse a better place for us all. Show off your best screenshot that embodies heroism, grit, or selflessness, especially when helping out someone in need. Drake has always had your back, and now we want to honor those players who go the extra mile as well.  Some examples of the types of screenshots we are looking for: Reviving a teammate in a combat zone or providing another player with an escort through a dangerous route. Helping a friend move cargo or assisting someone with any task. Answering a rescue beacon or delivering much-needed supplies like food and drink. Refueling a stranded Citizen or providing a tow for a disabled ship. Please read the contest rules carefully to avoid disqualification. :camera_with_flash: Capture: Either snap a screenshot of an act of everyday heroism or recreate one you've experienced. If it made a difference to someone, it counts.  :outbox_tray: Submit: Post your entry to the Community Hub, using the DefenseCon announcement at the top of the Community Hub page. Multiple submissions are allowed throughout the event period, so feel free to experiment and try different ideas. Keep In Mind! Posts must be submitted to the Community Hub within the correct DefenseCon category. Each submission must clearly reflect an act of goodwill, selflessness, or perseverance that benefits someone in need. Post-processing effects are not allowed. AI-generated or AI-edited content is not allowed Replies to this thread will not count as submissions. Multiple players may appear in your screenshot, but group collaborations are not allowed. Only the submitting player is eligible to win. Multiple submissions are allowed. title: Re: Billions of AUEC already being sold
summary: The claims around billions of aUEC circulating right now don’t line up with what we’re currently seeing internally. While I can’t get into specifics around monitoring or enforcement, our tools and visibility today are significantly more robust than they were previously, and we absolutely will take action and clean things up where needed. Since the economy is server-side, we have a pretty clear picture of the overall economy, and the highest balances we’re currently seeing are still only in the millions (not even 5% of a billion).  It’s also important to note that it’s pretty common for RMT sellers to attempt to sell currency they do not actually have, especially after an economy reset. Aside from being against the TOS, there’s also a pretty high likelihood of getting scammed.

summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates. Space Combat Missions - Defend Location Adding missions where players are now defending a location from NPC Attackers. This includes a standalone mission and a compounding one where players will have multiple conflicting priorities to complete. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.

title: Re: Will you say anything about Ironclad ?
summary: Hey there,  The teams have tracked, reproduced, and are currently working on multiple fixes for the Ironclad.  I can confirm that several of the top Ironclad Issue Council reports are actively being addressed, including: Ironclad switching from NAV mode to SCM mode → Fixed internally and ready for implementation Command Module separating from the Ironclad during quantum travel → Fixed internally and ready for implementation Suffocating inside the Ironclad → Actively under investigation. While we’ve fixed most of the door air gap issues, there are still a few missing atmosphere pockets in the Ironclad Assault caused by door geometry. We’re continuing to work on those fixes. We’re also aware of others issues involving for example the Ironclad radar, persistent quantum sound loops, random explosions while docked, third-person camera focus being locked to the Command Module, lights that cannot be turned off, or trespassing warnings. We truly appreciate all your reports on the Issue Council, they help the teams reproduce, investigate, and resolve these issues much faster.  Thanks again for your patience while we continue working on improvements.

title: Re: Still holding the line, but I’m also tired.
summary: Hi folks,  Quick update on several issues we've been tracking. Many are in progress, but here are the freshest ones:   :white_check_mark: Hotfixed to Live recently Some ships could not be claimed through "Claim Insured Loadout" The mobiGlas Starmap "Route" button had an incorrect interaction area. In cases where the button itself was not responsive, the clickable area was shifted slightly to the right. You could still reliably use [R] to set routes. Docking issues preventing both manual and automatic docking at certain stations have also been hotfixed to Live.  :white_check_mark: Fixed (May 21, reminder) Purchased pledge items not appearing in-game should now be resolved with the new Individual Claim Mode: Freight elevators now include a new "Claim Mode" button at your home location. This allows you to reclaim platform-owned ship items such as paints and gear individually back to your home inventory. Previously owned instances of claimed items will be invalidated automatically. For easier navigation, there is also an "Exclude Paints" filter option available. If you are still missing pledged items after the update, please perform a Character Repair and let us know if the issue persists afterward. We continue to monitor this one.  :hammer_and_wrench: Reproduced and In Progress Scanning and targeting currently don't function correctly when the Command Module is docked to a host vehicle. Scanning is failing to return signatures for vehicles and objects in this state. The team has successfully reproduced the issue and work is ongoing.  :mag: Investigating We are actively investigating your reports regarding lost Personal Hangars. We know how disruptive this issue is and are currently investigating solutions, though it may not make the 4.8 release window. We'll keep you in the loop.  :hourglass_flowing_sand: Fixed, Awaiting Implementation An issue causing the Syulen interaction buttons to become difficult or impossible to press has been fixed two hours ago and is currently awaiting implementation into an upcoming build. Regarding duplication exploits, this remains an active area of focus for the teams. Several fixes have already gone out, and we greatly appreciate everyone continuing to report these issues through the Issue Council or directly to us. We are actively tracking and working on additional exploits fixes as well.  We'll have more news soon as we continue to hammer the issues you have been reporting recently.  Cheers,

title: Re: Any update on Global Illumination?
summary: It doesn't need any new stuff adding to a scene for it to work, and in fact it still leans on the baked/runtime probes for transparent surfaces and mid/low quality settings, so a lot of scenes "just work". On the other hand, it changes lighting behaviour enough that some scenes look quite different and need sanity checking by an artist. Besides those, yes, you have scenes where people have added fake lights that might be doing strange things, or very bright emissive surfaces where the exact brightness didn't matter so much until now.
body_html: It doesn't need any new stuff adding to a scene for it to work, and in fact it still leans on the baked/runtime probes for transparent surfaces and mid/low quality settings, so a lot of scenes "just work". Besides those, yes, you have scenes where people have added fake lights that might be doing strange things, or very bright emissive surfaces where the exact brightness didn't matter so much until now.

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hello everyone! I’m happy to announce that 4.8.1 which is coming soon will fix the majority of remaining UI issues for VR. This includes marker, salvage and tractor overlays. This rework is only active in VR for now and there are a bunch of console variables which can be tuned for your liking with more to come in the future.  ui_markers.enabled_3d: Enables the new 3D world space marker system. When disabled, markers use the legacy 2D screen space positioning. This is already forced on in VR but can be used to enable the 3d markers in desktop mode too. Longterm the 2d version will be removed.  ui_markers.scale_3d: Adjusts the overall size of all 3D markers.  ui_markers.offscreen_distance_3d: Controls how far from the camera offscreen (edge) markers are placed in world space.  ui_markers.offscreen_angle_3d: Controls how close offscreen markers appear to the edge of the screen. Higher values place them closer to the field of view boundary.  ui_markers.bounds_offset_scale_3d: Adjusts the distance between markers and the tracked object. Increase this value to move labels further away from the object.  ui_markers.bounds_offset_angle_3d: Adds an angular offset to marker positioning at longer distances.  If you have any issues or suggestions please let me know!  What is still planned:  - Global variable to set opacity for markers - Change opacity of Markers on the backside of a planet  Fly safe o7 SilvanCIG

title: Roadmap Roundup - June 3, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team Alpha 4.8 Space Combat Missions - Defend Location Implementing a new Mission Pack for players to answer the call from either Foxwell or Headhunters. Defend asteroid bases throughout the systems, prevent the attackers from destroying key resources, and sometimes escort escaping workers to safety. :scroll: This card has been set to Released.   Alpha 4.9 Siege of Orison Implementing a new operation, Siege of Orison, introducing instanced FPS  gameplay where players assault Nine Tails-controlled platforms in  coordinated team-based encounters tied to mission-driven progression. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Instancing Implementing Instancing to create closed gameplay spaces with controlled accesses. Access is managed through instance prerequisites, party leader ownership, and safeguards that prevent or remove ineligible players. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Super Heavy Combat Armor Implementing the Super Heavy armor class, enabling players to equip and operate a new category of powerful super heavy weapons. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG Implementing a brand new weapon type: the Heavy Machine Gun, with the Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG. Belt-fed and usable with the new Super Heavy Armor and its dedicated ammunition backpack, it delivers sustained high-rate fire from a large rotating barrel while carrying up to four magazines of ammunition. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Combat Clothing Implementing lightly armored apparel designed to offer a more stylish look while remaining viable in combat situations. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  New Wikelo Ships Offerings (4.9.0) Adding a Drake Clipper with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Mission Giver: Recco Battaglia Implementing a returning NPC to the Persistent Universe: Recco coordinates logistics for the local independent miners operating from Levski.  :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.

title: Star Citizen Alpha 4.8.1 LIVE - Hotfix 11952564
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.8.1 LIVE Alpha Patch 4.8.1 has now been released onto the LIVE Environment with a new hotfix! Launcher should now show: VERSION 4.8.1-LIVE.11952564.  Important Build Info     Long Term Persistence: Enabled     Starting aUEC: 20,000  This Spectrum post is an abridged version of the notes. For the full in-depth details, please visit the main notes at the link below! Star Citizen Alpha 4.8 LIVE Release Notes   Feature Updates  Player Trade Notifications Refactor with Economy Authorization Service Replacing the player aUEC trade flow with an authorization-ticket model that will require both parties to consent to the trade before it completes. The receiving player will receive a notification alert when aUEC is sent, prompting them to accept or deny. The sender will have a pending message. If not accepted in time by the receiver, the transaction will cancel. This system also introduces trade rate limits and amount caps.  For further information on aUEC trades, head on over to the community post about this topic https://robertsspaceindustries.com/spectrum/community/SC/forum/3/thread/player-to-player-trade-update   Hangar Collision Insurance Update Players will now receive a free insurance claim when their ship is destroyed due to collision inside a hangar.   Experimental VR Updates: 3d UI Markers & Tractor AR Added new 3D Versions for all marker types which can be activated with CVAR "ui_markers.enabled_3d", i.e. Vehicle Entrance, Object Markers, POI Markers, proper 3D transformation to Jump point markers. Tractor and Structural AR: 2D version has been removed. Desktop also uses the new 3D version now.  IMPORTANT Notes: The 3D versions look slightly different but they are almost identical to the 2D version: New projection helpers have been added to calculate the proper AR RTT local space position and the projected distance which scales with FOV and distance so 3D elements have always the same size New Cvars: ui_markers.enabled_3d - Switches markers between legacy 2D screenspace positioning and the new 3D world-space transform system. ui_markers.scale_3d - Uniform size scale applied to all 3D markers. ui_markers.max_distance_3d - Clamps the render distance of 3D markers to avoid floating-point precision issues from Building Blocks 32-bit coordinate space. ui_markers.offscreen_distance_3d - World-space distance from the camera at which offscreen (edge) markers are placed. ui_markers.offscreen_angle_3d - How far from screen centre offscreen markers sit, in degrees. Higher values push them closer to the FOV edge. ui_markers.offscreen_pitch_offset_3d - Tilts the reference forward direction for offscreen markers; intended for VR comfort tuning. ui_markers.bounds_offset_scale_3d - Flat multiplier on the above/below offset used to position labels relative to the ship's bounds. Increase to push labels further away from the ship body. ui_markers.bounds_offset_angle_3d - Angular offset (degrees) added to the 3D bounds position at range. pl_visor_markerAR.hud_ar_projected_size_scale - Scales the entire UI by this factor which uses the projected size   Bugfixes & Technical Escort Ship missions are currently unavailable while we test fixes for blocking issues. Once the fixes are confirmed as resolved, the missions will re-appear in your Contracts Manager on LIVE. This update includes multiple client and server stability improvements and crash fixes.  This update also includes half a dozen exploit fixes. Due to the nature of these, they will not be listed.  We've completed further technical work to address the character repair causing a number of accounts to "brick" and have included that in today's hotfix. Potential Fix: Issue where the active route would reset when switching between SCM and NAV modes on ships equipped with the Command Module Potential Fix: Issue where vehicles would stop mid-flight or during Quantum Travel and the Command Module would undock on its own Potential Fix: The interaction prompt for the Cargo Module disappears after reclaiming insured vehicles with the Cargo Module equipped Potential Fix: Issue where Quantum Travel markers did not behave correctly when a route was set on an Ironclad or Caterpillar spawned with the Command Module attached Potential Fix: Issue where the "Route" button's clickable area did not match its visible UI element on the Starmap Potential Fix: Issue where players were unable to dock at spaceports using Docking Collars across multiple systems Potential Fix: Issue where the MISC Starfarer's external fuel tanks could be detached via the fuel console without first unlocking the vehicle item ports. Potential Fix: Issue where Meteor weapons could be swapped out for generic Size 5 weapons Potential Fix: Issue where the Aegis Tiburon pilot lost their targeting pips when another player entered a remote turret. Potential Fix: Issue where targeting pips jittered out of place in the Aegis Tiburon Potential Fix: Issue where Mustang Delta rockets used incorrect ammunition and carried too few rounds Potential Fix: Issue where Bit Zero's ship would not spawn in the hangar during the Easy Pickings mission in Pyro Potential Fix: Issue where the UtiliFlex Crossbow bolt appeared as a white box instead of the correct visual Potential Fix: Thruster textures are missing on some Anvil Hornet variants Potential Fix: Issue where a generic transaction error was displayed at the end of a successful AI refueling transaction. Potential Fix: Issue where multiple panels in Riker Memorial Spaceport displayed placeholder images Potential Fix: Issue where doors in the Specimen Cache Room at Lazarus Complex in Stormageddon remained open after a reset. Potential Fix: Ship Hangar Services - Mustang Delta rockets use S9 ammo and way too little of it Potential Fix: Issue causing the Syulen buttons to be difficult to press Potential Fix: Defend Bunker Friendly NPCs despawn once the timer reaches 00:00 Potential Fix: Fuel Nozzles bought on refinery shop does not appear on local inventory

title: Player-to-Player Trade Update
summary: Hi everyone,  With the latest 4.8 update, we've made some changes to how player-to-player transactions work. We wanted to give you a heads-up on what's changing, and be upfront that this is an area we'll be actively adjusting over the coming days and weeks.    What's New Trades between players now require both parties to be online, with the recipient acknowledging the transaction before it completes. This helps ensure transfers are intentional and confirmed on both ends.  The online requirement is a temporary step. In the future, we plan to support offline notification resolution, which will let you send a trade offer to a player who's offline while still preserving the acknowledgment flow. Until that's in place, both players will need to be online to complete a trade.  In addition, the UEE Bank now performs authorization verification on transactions, including limits on transaction rates and amounts.    Our Approach to Limits Our goal is to keep trade frictionless for players going about their normal business, while giving us the tools to identify and restrict abuse. We're working toward a flexible system of limits with multiple tiers, so that legitimate activity sits comfortably within them while unusual patterns can be flagged without affecting everyone else.  We don't expect to land on the right values straight away. Finding the balance will take some tuning, and we'll be adjusting as we learn more from real activity in the 'verse.    What to Expect Over the next few days and weeks, you may notice changes to rate limiting and transaction thresholds as we calibrate things. Some limits may feel conservative at first while we gather data and find the right settings. If something feels off, that feedback is genuinely useful to us during this period.   Thanks for bearing with us as we tune these systems. We appreciate your patience while we get this right.

title: Re: Unable to connect to PU ... hung at 'News' loading screen forever.
summary: Edit 4:  Character repair is back on so that 64006 accounts can get back in game but please keep in mind that the results of the character repair may cause gear and other items to go missing due to the reset.   Edit 3:  Short term fixes ( including the tool we made for this ) don't seem to be working well for these issues. Investigations will continue but for the time being we're not going to continue trying these temporary workarounds.   Edit 2: I've confirmed with a few players that a character repair fixes the 64006 issue but they're also reporting that it is causing them to have gear and other items go missing afterwards. Because of this, character repair has been disabled.   Edit: Ok. Players that were affected by the 64010 can try logging in again.  I've verified with a few players that the repair tool that we ran worked  but the tool is relatively new so it's worth checking to see if  anything went missing so we can report that.  Original message: Wanted to give an update here so that people aren't left hanging even though it hasn't been resolved.   This is an issue on our end rather than a tech support problem. On the backend, it's pretty similar to the 60029 issue players were getting. The error I get when I try to stow accounts affected by the 64010 disconnection error is the exact same error as the 60029.   Good news is that since my last update on the 60029 error, we have a tool to fix accounts that get into that state now. We're going to have to compile list of affected accounts and provide it to the dev that made that tool. Once it's done munching through them, I'll update here again so people can try logging in to see if it worked ( I have no ETA on this, as several steps in that process are outside of the scope of work I do ).

title: Alpha 4.8.1 Known Issues Update
summary: Hey everyone,  We’ve seen a lot of reports and feedback come in since the release of Alpha 4.8.1, and the teams are working hard to address the issues you’ve been raising.  Before diving into the list, we want to acknowledge that some of these issues are having a significant impact on your game experience. Our teams have been spending a great deal of time investigating reports, reviewing logs, reproducing issues internally, and deploying fixes where possible. While some issues can be resolved quickly, generally through a hotfix, others require additional investigation to fully understand and address. We wanted to share where things currently stand on some of the most visible reports. Please note that the list is not exhaustive.   :scroll: Currently Investigating The following issues are actively being investigated, tested, or reviewed by the team: Inventory becoming unavailable, with backpack, station, and loot inventories appearing empty or inaccessible. We've identified a likely cause and are continuing to work through it with the goal of getting a fix in place as soon as we can. We've seen the reports around docking issues and are actively working to reproduce and isolate the causes behind them. Mined ores disappearing after storing a vehicle. Current investigation points toward resource container values reverting to a previously serialized state after stow/unstow. QV Warehouse loot not respawning or resetting correctly if cargo is looted without progressing through the mission, preventing subsequent players from accessing intended rewards. The team is actively testing potential fixes and reviewing the mission flow. Ironclad oxygen issues affecting multiple rooms: Resolved for most locations, with a small number of remaining reports still under investigation. A more comprehensive solution is planned for an upcoming update. Crafted item stats not always appearing in item descriptions while inside inventory spaces, making it difficult to verify item properties after crafting. Refueling notifications and Helpful Hints can become stuck and prevent notifications, party invites, mission shares, and other UI prompts from appearing correctly. The following workaround could help you out while we're working on a solution: Enable Helpful Hints and Keybind Hints in the Game Settings, close the menu, reopen it, then disable both options again and close the menu. Notifications should begin functioning normally again, though previously queued notifications may still appear afterward. Shard lock issues preventing some players from joining or remaining connected to sessions. This remains one of our high-priority investigations. We've already identified and addressed several contributing issues, and the team is continuing to work through additional fixes. Drake Command Module playing Quantum Travel spooling audio when spawned or streamed while attached to a host vehicle. This issue is known and under review for a future update.   :hourglass: Pending Implementation Potential fixes pending implementation to the Live version, fixed internally: Fuel nozzles on ships cannot be detached and swapped. Starfarer refuel exchange displaying incorrect values between microSCU and SCU. Players can asphyxiate inside the Drake Command Module despite having a helmet equipped. Pressure and temperature levels can spike drastically during navigation in the Drake Command Module due to atmosphere-related issues. Players can experience high pressure levels in certain areas of the Ironclad after undocking and re-docking the Command Module. Ironclad tractor beam range of motion and camera controls have been improved for better usability and cargo handling. ROC, ROC-DS, and Prospector mining heads now align more accurately with the mining reticle, improving mining precision. Visual issues affecting Banu Defender and Aopoa Khartu-Al paints have been resolved. Players can once again exit the Argo MPUV Tractor pilot seat reliably using standard exit controls. The MIRAI Guardian radar display orientation has been corrected. Material issues affecting the front hull of the MISC Prospector have been fixed. Material issues affecting the Stinger canopy and HUD have been fixed, reducing excessive visual artifacts from rain and wear effects. F7 Mk I turret weapons now persist correctly and can once again be swapped as intended.   :white_check_mark: Fixed The following issues have been fixed in the current Live version: Drake Command Module unexpectedly undocking during Quantum Travel or general flight. Fixed in 4.8 11904230. Aegis Tiburon tracking pips jittering out of position. Fixed in 4.8 11930495. Syulen interaction buttons being difficult or impossible to use. Fixed in 4.8 11940252. And more recent fixes in 4.8.1 LIVE - Hotfix 11952564.   :eye: Additional Reports We're Tracking The teams are also working hard on the following issues: Freight Elevators becoming stuck in personal hangars and blocking cargo access. Freight Elevators becoming stuck at outposts, preventing hauling missions from being completed. Missing Quantum Markers impacting navigation to destinations across the PU. Missing Jump Point markers after transiting in the Ironclad. Ironclad atmosphere inconsistencies affecting environmental conditions aboard the ship. Extremely low interior temperatures being reported inside certain ships. Command Module radar displays failing to appear in some situations. Moving an undersuit into inventory causing equipment functionality issues.   We'll continue to share updates through our Patch Notes threads and on Spectrum. For known issues and available workarounds, the Known Issues thread remains a great resource and is regularly updated as new information becomes available.  We'll also continue to keep you informed through the Status Page whenever degraded performance is detected. This doesn't necessarily mean a server outage has occurred, but rather that we're investigating elevated error rates or other service disruptions that may be impacting the experience.  As always, thank you for your reports, especially on the Issue Council, as it plays a crucial role in helping us identify, investigate, and resolve issues.

Each race has its own history, its own culture, its own way of seeing the 'verse. This Alien Week, we want to see how that inspires you. Welcome to the Alien Week 2956 - Xeno Craft Challenge!  Break out your tools, unleash your creativity, and bring the alien cultures to life with your own two hands. Food, art, props, models, costumes: whatever you can dream up and build, we want to see it!  Before you start on your creations, please read the contest rules carefully and remember to post your entries to the Alien Week 2956 event page on the Community Hub, not as a reply to this thread. Entries with unrelated subjects will be disqualified. Submissions must include progress photos showing the creation process. AI-generated content is not permitted. A moment that would change the course of history forever, now celebrated across the UEE as First Contact Day. Since then, we've traded with the Banu, built a lasting peace with the Xi'an, assimilated the Tevarin, and clashed with the Vanduul. Each race has its own history, its own culture, its own way of seeing the 'verse. This Alien Week, we want to see how that inspires you. Welcome to the Alien Week 2956 - Xeno Craft Challenge! Break out your tools, unleash your creativity, and bring the alien cultures to life with your own two hands. Food, art, props, models, costumes: whatever you can dream up and build, we want to see it! Before you start on your creations, please read the contest rules carefully and remember to post your entries to the Alien Week 2956 event page on the Community Hub, not as a reply to this thread. Entries with unrelated subjects will be disqualified. Submissions must include progress photos showing the creation process. AI-generated content is not permitted. Each post counts as one entry, and you may submit multiple entries. Multiple photos can be included within a single post. Group submissions are not allowed. Only the person posting the images can win a prize. Submissions that don't follow these instructions will be disqualified. Make sure to read the full contest rules for details. Join the conversation: Xi’an Language Discussion Banu Language Discussion Good luck, and we can't wait to see what you make!

title: Roadmap Roundup - June 17, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team Alpha 4.8 Gatac Railen Implementing the Gatac Railen. Human-operable yet distinctly alien, the Railen bursts into long-haul transport with agility, vertical design, and remarkable grav-lev employment. :scroll: This card has been set to Released.  Gatac Tyilui Implementing the Gatac Tyilui, the first alien-designed carrier on the market, and also the first ship with a zero-gravity hangar, allowing for an aerial ballet of weightless operation. :scroll: This card has been set to Released.   Alpha 4.9 Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements Implementing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements, updating ship and item recovery to better support custom loadouts through timed claims, optional expedite fees, freight elevator item claims, and debuting a free recovery option when losses are detected as outside the player’s control. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Nine Tails Armor Update Implementing updated armor sets for the Nine Tails criminal organization, refreshing the appearance of grunts, elites, and boss NPCs. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle Implementing the Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle, a battle rifle purpose-built for close-quarters engagements, combining the compact handling of a bullpup design with the firepower needed for intense frontline and boarding combat. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Ordnance Cargo Holder Implementing dedicated storage frames for missiles, torpedoes, and bombs placed on cargo grids to improve presentation and handling. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  New Hairstyles (4.9.0) Implementing two new hairstyles, along with an update to one hairstyle to bring it up to current quality standards. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.

title: [EVO NDA] Star Citizen Alpha 4.9 PTU Patch Notes 12098675
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.9  Alpha Patch 4.9 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.9.0-PTU.12098675. Audience: Evocati (Standard Evo NDA) Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only Long Term Persistence: Enabled  Testing/Feedback Focus Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases Instanced Siege of Orison (Will be focusing on the 1st Island in today's build) New Story Missions: Recco Battaglia Warning: There are going to be lots of content items in partial states of finished. Currently all balance and features are WIP  Known Issues PU - Ship Battles - Missions / Locations - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted Front End - Main Menu - Social / Add Friends - UI - Clicking add friends whilst in the main menu will make your UI uninteractable PU - Ship Battles V2 - EscortShips - Mission Content / AI - Escorted ship does not Quantum Travel away or Go to the Hangar after neutralizing the AI ships in the mission location PU - Missions - Bounty Hunter / Mission Content - When killing the Neutralize target the mission does not progress PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison V2 - Instancing / Mission / Locations - Server Error Causes Platforms to Despawn at SoO With this issue, if a server error does happen, you will need to leave and create a new instance, potentially reforming the party with a new leader. PU - Stanton - SOOV2 - Transport / Mission Content - Shuttle from Solanki to Hartmoore has no collision  PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Locations - Rooftop balcony cannot be accessed by players naturally on Solanki Platform  Because of these issues, we will only be focusing on the first island of Siege of Orison tonight Multi-System - PU - Locations / Inventory - There's a chance that their primary residence does not contain their items' Workaround: Recopy account if you need your default local items   Features & Gameplay Gameplay Instanced Siege of Orison Siege of Orison returns as a fully reworked, instanced co-operative FPS mission. This update introduces Mission Instancing to Star Citizen for the first time, a system that creates a private, closed environment shared only by you and your party.   This new version of Siege of Orison removes ship combat entirely and redesigns the experience as a focused, three-island FPS mission set in the Inspiration Park cluster. Ninetails have locked down access to the islands, overriding local security systems and stationing their lieutenants and the commander throughout the platforms. Crusader Security has contracted InterSec to get control back. Your objective on each island is the same: clear through the Ninetails resistance, reset the Security Network Control Towers, defeat the island Lieutenant, and flip the IFFI to restore Crusader's airspace control then move to the next island.  Each island is progressively more difficult, with the final island culminating in a boss fight against Mendo Ren inside the Admin Center barge. Level design across all three islands has been updated for better sightlines, improved combat flow, and navigation that suits the instanced, no-ship format. Tonight's test will focus highly on the 1st island.     // Instancing & Siege of Orison Closed Instance - Max 4 Players When you enter the instance elevator, it locks to you and your party. No other players can join without being invited. The maximum party size for this instance is four. If you try to enter as a group of six, the first four are admitted and the remaining two are notified they cannot enter. Entering & Mission Acceptance An optional one-time Intro Contract is available anywhere in Stanton that directs first-time players to the instance entrance at the Crusader Showroom Rooftop. On any subsequent visit, you can enter directly. When you step into the instance, the Siege of Orison mission is automatically accepted for everyone in the party with no manual pickup required. Entering Solo You can enter the instance alone and play solo, or share the auto-accepted mission with other players to allow them to join your instance after you are inside. Entrance Location Take the elevator to the Crusader Showroom Rooftop in Orison. From there, board the shuttle to the Instance Transit Platform and enter the instance via the elevator on the platform. The transit platform serves as a staging area between islands throughout the mission.   New Mission Giver: Recco Battaglia In tonight's build, we will have the new narrative story missions from Recco Battaglia available. You'll get to play all three chapters for which the first one is available from by default, though Chapters 2 and 3 are available once you've gained enough reputation by completing other repeatable contracts Battaglia is offering. To ensure you get to experience all of these missions in a reasonable timeframe, we've lowered the reputation requirements for the later missions. You will be able to see and accept these missions in the mobiGlas while in Nyx.     Bugfixes & Technical - Fixed 12 Client Crashes - Fixed 7 Server Crashes - Fixed 2 Hybrid-Service Crashes - Fixed multiple issues causing server hangs Potential Fix: PU - Inventory - Inventory becomes unavailable and contents of backpack/station/loot inventory is empty (STARC-211218) Potential Fix: PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison V2 - Locations / Instancing - Instance will despawn after a short period of time (STARC-212318) Piotential Fix: PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison V2 - Instancing / Mission / Locations - Server Error Causes Platforms to Despawn at SoO Potential Fix: Multi-Item - PU - Crafting / Mineables - Crafting Uses Entire Stack of Gemstones stored in the player's inventory instead of what the recipe requires (STARC-200943) Potential Fix: PU - Actor - Movement / Camera - Head wobble with "Camera Spring Movement" enabled is severe (STARC-212807) Potential Fix: Hull A floating Blade card (STARC-204857) Potential Fix: RSI Pembroke Backpack Set - PU - Actor - Armor - Art - Pembroke Backpacks have incorrect color textures compared to their store references (STARC-117269) Potential Fix: Multi-Location - PU - Stanton - Vehicles / Instanced Hangar / Locations - Retrieving a vehicle while another occupies the hangar platform will cause the retrieved vehicle to instantly spawn & clip through the vehicle occupying the platform (STARC-195834) Potential Fix:  AC - G suit loadout is not on all modes for flight combat (STARC-204867) Potential Fix: PU - Hangar / Vehicles - Retrieving vehicles spawn at the middle of the solar system (STARC-206713) Potential Fix: MULTIVEHICLE - PU - Vehicles - Multiple vehicles spawn incorrect hangar size (STARC-186642) Potential Fix: PU - Creatures - Juvenile Valakkar - Juvenile Emerges then floats in the air Potential Fix: Aegis Hammerhead - PU - Vehicles / Elevators / Quantum Travel - Cockpit elevator that was lowered before quantum travel will move up after quantum travel Potential Fix: Multivehicle - PU - Vehicles - The interaction points for the gadget / handgun weapon slots are offset on the Railen / Tyilui Potential Fix: Gatac Tyilui - PU - Vehicles / Lighting - Shadows present on the steps leading to the cargo hold will draw in and cull at a very noticeable distance from the player Potential Fix: Multivehicle - PU - Vehicles / Medical - The medical bed of a bricked vehicle is still functional Potential Fix: Crusader Hercules Starlifter ( All Variants ) - PU - Vehicles - The back ramp and ramp panels of the ship are not present (STARC-212904) Potential Fix: Esperia Glaive ALL Variants - PU - Vehicles / UI - Esperia Glaive uses Vanduul MFD style instead of Esperia style Potential Fix: PU - UI - Refuelling - Pod integrity bar does not update Potential Fix: PU - Creatures - UI / Narrative - Several creatures display a placeholder string name when ping-scanned from a vehicle Potential Fix: Drake Cutlass ( Some Variants ) - PU - Vehicles - Engineering Screen / Graphics / Vehicle Feature – Engineering Screen are blocked by grey colored panel
