summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.9 Alpha Patch 4.9 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.9.0-PTU.12107679.     Audience: Evocati (Standard Evo NDA)     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus     Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases     Instanced Siege of Orison (Will be focusing on the 1st Island in today's build)     New Story Missions: Recco Battaglia Vehicle Armor Hit Marker Feedback Warning: There are going to be lots of content items in partial states of finished. Currently all balance and features are WIP  Known Issues    Destroy Narcotics missions disabled temporarily due to a structural refactor  PU - Ship Battles - Missions / Locations - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted     Front End - Main Menu - Social / Add Friends - UI - Clicking add friends whilst in the main menu will make your UI uninteractable     PU - Ship Battles V2 - EscortShips - Mission Content / AI - Escorted ship does not Quantum Travel away or Go to the Hangar after neutralizing the AI ships in the mission location     PU - Missions - Bounty Hunter / Mission Content - When killing the Neutralize target the mission does not progress     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison V2 - Instancing / Mission / Locations - Server Error Causes Platforms to Despawn at SoO With this issue, if a server error does happen, you will need to leave and create a new instance, potentially reforming the party with a new leader.     PU - Stanton - SOO - Transport / Mission Content - Shuttle from Solanki to Hartmoore has no collision PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Transport / Mission Content - Shuttle from Arrival Center to Solanki has no collision after leaving the transit at Solanki PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - There's an invisible wall at the center of the medical hub blocking players from going back to the elevator and clinic rooms on the upper platform of Solanki PU - Stanton - siege_all - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the moment the second forcefield turned green from "Standby" Because of these issues, we will only be focusing on the first island of Siege of Orison tonight     Multi-System - PU - Locations / Inventory - There's a chance that their primary residence does not contain their items' Workaround: Recopy account if you need your default local items   Features & Gameplay Gameplay Battaglia (Recco Battaglia) Added weapon racks and specific loot configurations to the QV Station interior. Added loot placements and weapon racks to the Battaglia outlaw asteroid base. Added a minimap to the Battaglia outlaw asteroid bases. Fixed missing ledge grab markup on assets in the Battaglia outlaw asteroid bases' Cargo Room and Central Hub. Fixed missing lever blocking part of Island 1’s tower.  Instanced Siege of Orison Replaced generic loot presets with Siege of Orison-specific variants. Checkpoint respawn flow implemented for the mission. Implemented fusebox interactable for comms tower node. Loot on civilian AI corpses updated to be contextually appropriate (food and drink, rather than knives and ammo). Further areas on Island #1 should now be more available after a fix to the lever missing inside the comms tower node.  Vehicle Armor Hitmarker Feedback Hit markers when firing on vehicles will now reflect the result of each shot based on armor and penetration calculations. Players will see distinct markers to indicate whether a shot hit shields, impacted the hull, penetrated armor, destroyed an internal component, or was deflected entirely.  Shield hits Hull hits Armor penetration Internal component destruction Deflection (shot blocked/bounced) Note: The hit marker state for component/ship destruction is not yet fully implemented and will be addressed in a follow-up patch    Bug Fixes & Technical - Fixed 3 Client Crashes - Fixed 2 Server Crashes Potential Fix: PU - Refueling - Actor / Vehicles - AI Refuel Beacon / Missions - UI / HUD - When a player dies and respawns after being refueled from an AI beacon, Helpful Hints for Refueling will remain on HUD blocking Notifications from appearing Potential Fix: Players spawning invisible and passing through hab walls when respawning at Orison or New Babbage Potential Fix: Battaglia Missions - Delivery locker sometimes failing to contain the delivery item during the Battaglia Story 3 hauling phase, causing the mission marker to point to an incorrect location Potential Fix: Battaglia Missions - Phase 3 objective in Battaglia contract displaying incorrect objective text ("Go To Mining Base" instead of "Reach Distress Signal") Potential Fix: Hammerhead and Tiburon unable to be entered via elevators or cargo bay due to missing interaction states Potential Fix: SoO -  Lever missing inside the comms tower node, blocking mission progression Potential Fix: Drake Ironclad (all variants) Command Station seat using an incorrect turret MFD setup Potential Fix: FPS compass pointing in incorrect directions inside ship interiors Potential Fix: AI pathfinder taking excessively long to validate whether a path is possible Potential Fix: Defend areas not being correctly assigned within the Siege of Orison instance Potential Fix: Vanduul fighters not spawning during the AssistShipInCombat mission phase in Nyx Potential Fix: Mission not progressing during To and From Escort phases for Defend Destructible Entities and Escort missions Potential Fix: Pitch black walls and floors in the New Deal interior caused by incorrect lighting values Potential Fix: Area 18 NPE tutorial not updating after the player takes the elevator to the lobby Potential Fix: Trip mines dealing no or significantly reduced damage to players

summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.9 Alpha Patch 4.9 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.9.0-PTU.12118066         Audience: Wave 1         Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only         Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus         Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases         Recco Battaglia Repeatable Missions (story missions disabled in tonight's build)     Vehicle Hit Marker Updates  Known Issues        Destroy Narcotics missions disabled temporarily due to a structural refactor      PU - Ship Battles - Missions / Locations - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted         PU - Ship Battles V2 - EscortShips - Mission Content / AI - Escorted ship does not Quantum Travel away or Go to the Hangar after neutralizing the AI ships in the mission location         PU - Missions - Bounty Hunter / Mission Content - When killing the Neutralize target the mission does not progress Front End - Socials / Add Friends - UI / Online Services - Searching for friends on the Add Friends search bar will result in a "Service Unavailable" PU - Commodity Kiosks - Multiple Locations - "Failed" error appears when buying RMC from Commodity Kiosks         Multi-System - PU - Locations / Inventory - There's a chance that their primary residence does not contain their items' Workaround: Recopy account if you need your default local items   Features & Gameplay     Gameplay Missile Cargo Grid Visuals & Ship Servicing Improvements Missiles/Torpedoes placed on a cargo grid will now display a bounding box frame around them, giving a clearer visual reference for the space each missile occupies. This frame is visible anywhere a cargo grid is present, including ship interiors and freight elevators. When snapping a missile into position, both the missile and its frame are now shown in the hologram preview, and players can choose the snapping direction during placement. Additionally, capital ships no longer need their pivot point fully inside a servicing zone to access hangar services, any portion of the ship overlapping the zone is now sufficient.   Vehicle Hit Marker Updates Further hit marker polish and updates for hitting components, armor penetration, and shields. title: Re: [Wave 1] Star Citizen Alpha 4.9 PTU Patch Notes 12135599
summary: Thanks for the feedback everyone. We really appreciate it.  PTU build 4.9.0-12135599 is part of a series of incremental changes that allow us to roll out updates, analyze the results, and continue iterating based on your feedback.  The Quantum fuel tank rebalance is the first step in that process. A follow-up update will be arriving very shortly to also rebalance Hydrogen fuel tanks as well. We look forward to hearing your feedback once that PTU update is available.  Cheers :slightly_smiling_face:
body_html: Thanks for the feedback everyone. We really appreciate it. PTU build 4.9.0-12135599 is part of a series of incremental changes that allow us to roll out updates, analyze the results, and continue iterating based on your feedback. The Quantum fuel tank rebalance is the first step in that process. A follow-up update will be arriving very shortly to also rebalance Hydrogen fuel tanks as well. title: [4.8.3 LIVE Feedback] Return of Xenothreat
summary: Greetings!  The Xenothreat outlaw group has emerged once again to threaten the Stanton system and its ongoing support of peaceful coexistence with non-Human races. Until July 15, there are five ways to combat the outlaw threat:  Come to the defense of alien-made ships that are under attack by isolationist forces Engage with waves of anti-alien fighters to relieve them of their misguided lives Lay in wait and eliminate the exclusionary elitists the moment they arrive Draw out their xenophobic lieutenants to weaken the villains' command structure Remove their Idris frigate by either destroying the ship or killing the pilot on board  A feedback survey is available at: Return of Xenothreat Survey Form. This survey will be open until July 31.  We look forward to reading your feedback!  -Shark Player Experience Team

title: Roadmap Roundup - July 1, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team We’d like to share an update on the upcoming Alpha 4.9.0 release, as well as our ongoing initiative to address many of the common bugs and issues that both new and veteran players encounter on a regular basis.  As mentioned during a recent Star Citizen Live, we've reassessed our bug prioritization process following the release of Alpha 4.8.0. As part of that effort, we've refined how we prioritize bugs, with increased involvement from Senior Leadership alongside our Development, QA, Player Experience, Community, and other supporting teams to help ensure we're focusing on the issues that will make the biggest impact.  We're hopeful this approach means you'll feel the difference: more issues fixed, and your gameplay sessions noticeably improving.  Based on reports from the Issue Council, Spectrum, Reddit, direct player feedback, and other sources, we have identified nearly 100 issues that significantly impact core gameplay systems and quality of life, covering areas including: Instanced Hangars, ATC, and Ship Retrieval Freight Elevators Quantum Travel and Starmap Routing Inventory UI and Interaction Ships being falsely marked as lost or destroyed Docking Ship and FPS AI Login Flow Exploits  In addition, we're tracking a broader list of quality-of-life issues frequently reported by new players. While many veteran players have learned workarounds for common problems, they shouldn't have to. As we continue working toward making Star Citizen as welcoming as possible for new players, we're also addressing many of the issues that commonly affect the first hour of gameplay.  For those who remember the state of Transit in early 2025, we're applying a similar philosophy here. At one point, months of bug fixing produced only incremental improvements, so we shifted our focus to developing new debugging tools for QA that could identify root causes rather than simply addressing symptoms. The result is what many would consider a far more robust Transit system today.  Freight Elevators are a good example of why this matters. Despite 70 to 80 fixes since last summer, players still don't feel the system is as stable or reliable as it should be. Much of that work addressed individual symptoms rather than the underlying causes. Freight Elevators interact with many other gameplay systems, creating a large surface area for issues, but as a core gameplay feature, they need to be dependable at all times.  So far, we've resolved roughly 20% of the issues on our current priority list. We don't expect to complete every fix in time for Alpha 4.9.0, but we're confident this more methodical, root-cause-driven approach is the right path forward for systems of Star Citizen's scale and complexity.  Naturally, an initiative like this comes with trade-offs. It requires dedicated time from several of the teams responsible for these core systems, time that would otherwise be spent developing new features or supporting additional content. As a result, we've temporarily paused work on a small number of features while we focus on improving the stability of these foundational systems.  With that in mind, we're moving Siege of Orison and all instance-related content out of Alpha 4.9.0 and into a new 4.10 scheduled for mid-August. These additional four weeks will allow us to continue hardening the features, and technology and related deliverables planned for that content.  Instancing, in particular, introduces a significant number of new systems, backend services, and gameplay mechanics that require additional validation before we're comfortable bringing them to Live. Based on the recent Tech Preview builds, we believe more work is still needed.  With these changes, Alpha 4.9 in mid-July will still deliver a variety of re-prioritized bug fixes, optimizations, quality of life improvements and new content we're excited to get into your hands as quickly as possible, reflective of this new initiative that continues beyond this month's release into 4.10 in August, and 4.11 this September.  As always, thank you for continuing to report issues through the Issue Council. Your reports, along with your feedback on Spectrum and through the Help Center, remain invaluable in helping us identify, investigate, and resolve issues. Release View Alpha 4.9 "Support the Miners" Mission Pack Implementing a new set of repeatable missions from Recco Battaglia, an independent mining logistics coordinator based in Levski. Take on a variety of contracts including prospecting, mining, recovery, salvage, investigations, ship reclamation, and more, while building your reputation with Recco to unlock additional opportunities in Alpha 4.9 and beyond. Contracts can be accepted through your mobiGlas. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Combat Clothing Implementing lightly armored apparel designed to offer a more stylish look while remaining viable in combat situations. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  New Hairstyles (4.9.0) Implementing two new hairstyles, along with an update to one hairstyle to bring it up to current quality standards. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Ordnance Cargo Holder Implementing dedicated storage frames for missiles, torpedoes, and bombs placed on cargo grids to improve presentation and handling. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle Implementing the Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle, a battle rifle purpose-built for close-quarters engagements, combining the compact handling of a bullpup design with the firepower needed for intense frontline and boarding combat. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Ship Combat UI Improvements Implementing new hit markers for vehicle combat, providing clearer feedback when landing shots. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Juvenile and Adult Valakkar Behavior Updates Implementing improvements to Juvenile and Adult Valakkar, updating their combat behavior with more dynamic burrowing, tracking, repositioning, and attack patterns. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed.  Ship Fly-By Audio Implementing an overhauled ship fly-by audio system, reintroducing fly-by sounds with all-new audio assets to deliver greater immersion and improved positional feedback during flight. :scroll: This card has been set to Committed. Alpha 4.10 Siege of Orison Implementing a new operation, Siege of Orison, introducing instanced FPS gameplay where players assault Nine Tails-controlled platforms in coordinated team-based encounters tied to mission-driven progression. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Instancing Implementing Instancing to create closed gameplay spaces with controlled accesses. Access is managed through instance prerequisites, party leader ownership, and safeguards that prevent or remove ineligible players. :scroll:This card has been set to Tentative. :scroll: This card has been moved from Star Citizen 1.0 to Alpha 4.10  Mission Giver: Recco Battaglia Introducing Recco Battaglia as an in-person Mission Giver in the Persistent Universe, bringing her first narrative mission series to life. Meet with Recco in Levski to uncover the challenges facing independent miners and begin a story that will continue through future chapters. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Super Heavy Combat "BUL-H4" Armor Implementing the Super Heavy Combat "BUL-H4" armor class, enabling players to equip and operate a new category of powerful super heavy weapons. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG Implementing a brand new weapon type: the Heavy Machine Gun, with the Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG. Belt-fed and usable with the new Super Heavy Armor and its dedicated ammunition backpack, it delivers sustained high-rate fire from a large rotating barrel while carrying up to four magazines of ammunition. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  New Wikelo Ships Offerings (4.10.0) Adding a Drake Clipper with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative. :scroll: This card has received a new asset.  Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements Implementing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements, updating ship and item recovery to better support custom loadouts through timed claims, optional expedite fees, freight elevator item claims, and debuting a free recovery option when losses are detected as outside the player’s control. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Nine Tails Armor Update Implementing updated armor sets for the Nine Tails criminal organization, refreshing the appearance of grunts, elites, and boss NPCs. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Fuel Tanks and Consumption Rebalance Implementing balance updates for Quantum and Hydrogen fuel tanks, adjusting fuel capacities and consumption rates to better align with ship sizes and roles. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.

title: [All Waves] Star Citizen Alpha 4.9 PTU Patch Notes 12148226
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.9 Alpha Patch 4.9 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.9.0-PTU.12148226 Audience: All Waves Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases Recco Battaglia Repeatable Missions Vehicle Hit Marker Updates Behring CQ7 Bullpup Rifle Vehicle Cleanup Updates at New Babbage and Stanton/Pyro Stations  Known Issues PU - Comms / Audio / VoIP - Proximity VOIP does not take over and party VOIP stops working at 60m meters and below Destroy Narcotics missions disabled temporarily due to a structural refactor PU - Ship Battles - Missions / Locations - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted PU - Ship Battles V2 - EscortShips - Mission Content / AI - Escorted ship does not Quantum Travel away or Go to the Hangar after neutralizing the AI ships in the mission location PU - Missions - Bounty Hunter / Mission Content - When killing the Neutralize target the mission does not progress PU - Commodity Kiosks - Multiple Locations - "Failed" error appears when buying RMC from Commodity Kiosks Multi-System - PU - Locations / Inventory - There's a chance that their primary residence does not contain their items' (Workaround: Recopy account if you need your default local items)   Features & Gameplay Gameplay With tonight’s build we have reverted QT fuel changes back to the current 4.8 SCU and burn rate amounts. This is something we are intending to bring back in with a future patch when the rest of the hydrogen fuel changes are ready.  Additional Gameplay Updates Nyx Resource Distribution: Common resource distribution adjusted at Glacium and Keeger HPP locations in Nyx Destroy Satellite Missions: Missions are now regional, preventing players from seeing and accepting satellite missions across all of Stanton Salvage mission unlock chain implemented for Adagio paid salvage contracts Commodity kiosks removed from Dumper's Depot and Platinum Bay and replaced with item kiosks. Jump drives added to Dumper's Depot Area18 shelving Food and drink added to Dumper's Depot inventory Additional shop kiosks added to New Deal ship dealership in Lorville Vanduul shields updated with improved glow and hexagon visual effects  Weapon & Item Updates Added New FPS Weapon: Behring CQ7 Bullpup Rifle Design Notes from Zac: After a year of very interesting sci-fi weapons  (and some very rusty ones), we heard a lot of feedback of wanting a nice standard lower RPM rifle to be added into the mix. So what better missing 'standard' than a bullpup? that and the amount of times I got sent the old concept art for the behring bullpup on spectrum over my time working here, I knew it had to be this. To make this stand out this weapon has a nice sharp TTK for a rifle but having a consistent and followable Y recoil shaped pattern, to those who learn it will be able to consistent land shots on target, Behring weapons typically always have very consistent and readable recoil and this weapon is no different, having a bit of 'bite' to its power but still in the 'feels smooth to use' that you expect from behring. Overall this is a great, all rounder daily driver type of rifle that won't let you down.  The weapon can be found in Ship In Distress missions as well as Moraine Data Retrieval and Moraine Movements both take you to the base where you can find the QB7.  Weight: Average Firemodes: Automatic / Burst Damage: 16.5 Projectile Velocity: 550 Aim down Sight Time: 0.25 RPM: 650 Mag size:  40    Bugfixes & Technical Tonight’s build has new density cleanup management for vehicles and ships at New Babbage and all stations in Stanton and pyro. These locations are to test to make sure it is behaving properly and not removing or storing things it shouldn’t be. Let us know if you see anything abnormal happening around these locations! Potential Fix: Interaction prompts appearing offset from what the player is looking at, making interactables difficult to use Potential Fix: Medical kiosk on medbeds at hospitals and medical vehicles not showing any interaction prompt Potential Fix: NPCs spawning in a T-pose due to missing animations Potential Fix: Eliminate All FPS missions having a chance to spawn an invisible NPC that could not be found or killed to complete the mission Potential Fix: Northrock Service Group not gaining reputation after completing Eliminate Specific missions Potential Fix: Crafting fabricator failing to disassemble items, returning an error Potential Fix: Drake Clipper thruster flaps not detaching on ship destruction Potential Fix: Contract generation failing validation for certain mission types, blocking contracts from being created

title: Re: [4.9 PTU] [Unsure if Bug] [CQ-7 Recoil profile]
summary: This is intended, it's to stop have these really harsh 'bouncy' feeling recoil resets which are present in a lot of the weapons because they just go on forever and it makes them lose a lot of weight, biggest offender is something like the P8AR currently  If you're just shooting it at a wall you'll notice it but when you use it in actual fire fights it works as expected since you're compensating and resetting that 'max'

title: [All Waves] Star Citizen Alpha 4.9 PTU Patch Notes 12206539
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.9 Alpha Patch 4.9 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.9.0-PTU.12206539     Audience: All Waves     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus     Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases     Recco Battaglia Repeatable Missions (reputation sped up for tonight)     Vehicle Hit Marker Updates     Behring CQ7 Bullpup Rifle     Vehicle Cleanup Updates     Vehicle Weapon Balance Pass Valakkar Behavior Updates Known Issues     Current hitmarker sounds are not playing the correct final audio and a solution is currently being looked into     PU - Armor / Clothing / Inventory Rework - "Right Click > Equip" does not function if a paper doll slot is occupied     PU - Nyx - StarMap / Locations - QV Breaker Stations can be traveled to anytime at Nyx without RCD missions active     PU - Ship Battles - Missions / Locations - Escort - Hangar doors are not opening for the ship that needs to be escorted     PU - Ship Battles V2 - EscortShips - Mission Content / AI - Escorted ship does not Quantum Travel away or Go to the Hangar after neutralizing the AI ships in the mission location     PU - Commodity Kiosks - Multiple Locations - "Failed" error appears when buying RMC from Commodity Kiosks   Features & Updates   ASOP Terminal Updates to ASOP terminal code to help ships that are currently spawning in transit to a pad to now correctly suppress the claim button, preventing a false claimable state during delivery. Further update have also been done to make it so the terminal can now correctly query vehicles stored in hangar inventory, preventing incorrect "Claim only" status on stored ships  Valakar Behavior Updates Updates to Valakar behaviors have been made to further distinguish types as well as fix issues previously encountered. Sentry Valakkars will not Bite and will instead hide if you get too close. Mobile Valakkars will move in combat to chase you down or reposition. Juvenile Valakkars now have a Bite Attack. Ensured that Valakkars always have a purpose in being above ground (reduces idle wiggling). Fixed bugs with some Valakkar attacks not doing damage.   Additional Updates Grenade HUD Markers: Live grenades will now display a warning marker on the HUD Hit Markers: Hit marker visuals have been updated to thinner markers and flat crosshairs for a cleaner look Bombing Run Missions: Bombing Run missions are now regional and will only appear in the area of space where the mission takes place, rather than being visible system-wide        Bug Fixes & Technical - Fixed a Client Crash Potential Fix: Contested Zone airlocks in Pyro not cycling correctly, preventing players from entering the zone Potential Fix: ATC defaulting landing requests to docking ports for ships that support both hangar and docking at dual-support locations such as Rest Stops, sending ships to the wrong landing type Potential Fix: Ships disappearing when landing at or departing from Levski hangars, with the vehicle being stowed incorrectly and freight elevator recovery stalling as a result Potential Fix: Vanduul-Tech Smugglers mission keycard or key-holding AI despawning before the player could retrieve them, blocking mission completion Potential Fix: Patrol Ship Battles mission failing to progress when one of the scan areas had no satellite in range Potential Fix: Second Yormandi failing to spawn at the Onyx Facility, and the first Yormandi sometimes failing to target hostile players after spawning Potential Fix: FPS Human combat AI surrendering during a fight when failing to immediately select a weapon despite having valid weapons available Potential Fix: Outlaw Legacy armor props (arms, core, legs) appearing as untextured material spheres when dropped or placed in the world Potential Fix: Irradiated Valakkar Fang displaying its internal string ID instead of its correct name when tractor beamed Potential Fix: ASOP terminal incorrectly showing a stored ship as "Claim only" instead of showing it as stored in the hangar Potential Fix: Armor carry props floating far away from the player's hands when picked up

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hey everyone! This time there aren't many VR changes for 4.9 as we are busy with other things so I'll post the few changes here instead of making a new thread: - VR Keybinds like Theater Mode Toggle, Tracking Reset should work now everywhere unless they are explicitly blocked. For example you can use them now during loading and in the frontend which was not possible before. - 3D Eva Direction Markers (in fact it was broken even in 2D, so now it should work again) - Screen-fading directly on the backbuffer so it also works in VR - Updated OpenXR from 1.0.50 to 1.1.60  > Implemented XR_EXT_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_VIEWS_CHANGE_EXTENSION_NAME. This means if you use SteamVR and change the resolution in the SteamVR settings it updates now in realtime in the engine! - Stereo Cursor Updates:  > Fix invisible cursor in ships with a radar  > Stereo cursor fully body aligned so it doesn't move anymore with external forces like water or trains, elevator  > Restrict cursor to g_headtracking_hmd_cursorMaxViewAngleDeg (default: 40 Degrees) so it no longer can get lost so easily. If you don't like this behavior just set a very high number for this cvar to restore the old behavior. - In EVA always force EHACM_DirectOffset as it was causing weird rotations otherwise (only relevant if GroundedLook is active)  Note: The VISOR Toggle is broken at the moment but will be restored with a hotfix soon. When this happens the Visor can also be toggled on desktop as many people requested.  Thanks for your time and fly safe o7 Silvan-CIG
body_html: Hey everyone! This time there aren't many VR changes for 4.9 as we are busy with other things so I'll post the few changes here instead of making a new thread: - VR Keybinds like Theater Mode Toggle, Tracking Reset should work now everywhere unless they are explicitly blocked. For example you can use them now during loading and in the frontend which was not possible before. - 3D Eva Direction Markers (in fact it was broken even in 2D, so now it should work again) - Screen-fading directly on the backbuffer so it also works in VR - Updated OpenXR from 1.0.50 to 1.1.60 > Implemented XR_EXT_VIEW_CONFIGURATION_VIEWS_CHANGE_EXTENSION_NAME. This means if you use SteamVR and change the resolution in the SteamVR settings it updates now in realtime in the engine! - Stereo Cursor Updates: > Fix invisible cursor in ships with a radar > Stereo cursor fully body aligned so it doesn't move anymore with external forces like water or trains, elevator > Restrict cursor to g_headtracking_hmd_cursorMaxViewAngleDeg (default: 40 Degrees) so it no longer can get lost so easily. If you don't like this behavior just set a very high number for this cvar to restore the old behavior. - In EVA always force EHACM_DirectOffset as it was causing weird rotations otherwise (only relevant if GroundedLook is active) Note: The VISOR Toggle is broken at the moment but will be restored with a hotfix soon. When this happens the Visor can also be toggled on desktop as many people requested. Thanks for your time and fly safe o7 Silvan-CIG

title: [4.9 LIVE Feedback] Vehicle Armor Hitmarkers
summary: Greetings!  Ships now provide visual and audio feedback on your reticle each time a shot connects, telling you exactly what your weapons are doing to a target in real time. Previously, ship combat provided no meaningful feedback on how shots were having an effect. Hit markers now change state based on the result of each shot, with a distinct audio cue for each outcome.  A feedback survey is available at: Vehicle Armor Hitmarkers Survey Form. This survey will be open until Aug 31.  We look forward to reading your feedback!  -Shark Player Experience Team

title: [4.9 LIVE Feedback] Abandoned Vehicle Cleanup Updates
summary: Greetings!  4.9 introduces updated cleanup code for abandoned ships around locations in the PU. This new code adds ship cleanup rules that will cleanup ships in an abandoned state after 5 hours to better reduce ship clutter around high impact locations. This code will affect all major landing zones and space stations in Stanton and Nyx, as well as Grim Hex, Levski, and other social stations across Nyx.  A feedback survey is available at: Abandoned Vehicle Cleanup Updates Survey Form. This survey will be open until Aug 31.  We look forward to reading your feedback!  -Shark Player Experience Team

title: Roadmap Roundup - July 15, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team Release View Alpha 4.9 The following cards have been set to Released. "Support the Miners" Mission Pack, Combat Clothing, New Hairstyles (4.9.0), Ordnance Cargo Holder, Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle, Ship Combat UI Improvements, Juvenile and Adult Valakkar Behavior Updates, Ship Fly-By Audio, Grey's Market Basher: Implementing the Grey's Market Basher. Smash, strike, and strafe your way through the black in a light fighter built from your old favorite parts. Nine Tails Armor Update: Implementing updated armor sets for the Nine Tails criminal organization, refreshing the appearance of grunts, elites, and boss NPCs. Moved from 4.10 to 4.9 Battaglia's Alliance Ships: Implementing three ships attainable through mission progression with Recco Battaglia in Levski, Nyx: the Drake Golem, MISC Prospector, and Argo MOLE, each featuring unique "Alliance" base liveries.   Alpha 4.10 Hedeby Gunworks "Arlington" Lever Action Rifle Implementing the Hedeby Gunworks "Arlington" Rifle, a lever-action long rifle that blends classic craftsmanship with modern functionality, delivering accurate marksmanship, smooth cycling, and multiple fire modes. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  New Weapon Attachment: Hedeby Gunworks S2 Optic Implementing a new attachment, the Hedeby Gunworks S2 Optic. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.

title: Alpha 4.9 - Frontier Tensions
summary: Hey y'all!   Life outside the UEE is hard-won. Now, an elusive group known as the Moraine is threatening the fragile stability the independent people of Nyx have fought to build.  The People’s Alliance requires your help. Scout safe locations for future operations, search for missing workers, board hijacked ships to rescue survivors, and recover valuable cargo from pirate raids. Where vessels can no longer be saved, salvage what's left behind and ensure every resource reaches its destination.  It’s dangerous work, but the people of Nyx remember those who stand beside them. Earn the trust of the People's Alliance and catch the attention of Recco Battaglia, a respected leader among the free people, who may have even greater opportunities for those willing to prove themselves…  That's just some of what's coming to the 'verse. Beyond Frontier Tension, Alpha 4.9 brings updates to the combat experience with revamped indicators designed to allow for better engagement and more informed combat when you need it most, as well as a new generation of fly-by audio, rebuilt from the ground up, delivering greater positional awareness and richer audio fidelity. Distribution Centers across the planets and moons of the ‘verse are being refreshed to resolve many long-standing mission bugs. This channel will point to the LIVE environment and using this will retain and add progress to your LIVE account as if you were playing normally. The best way to play on the HOTFIX channel, when one is available, is to rename your LIVE folder to HOTFIX and verify using the HOTFIX channel on the launcher. Reverse this process to go back to LIVE once it is released or you would like to stop using this channel.

title: Re: Is CIG trying to fully kill AC for new players?
summary: Hi All!  Thanks for bringing this to my attention - this was indeed not intended.   An update is being pushed to the AC Shop Service now. I go into more detail below.  Our intent is for one vehicle of each role listed below to be available in Arena Commander for free.  The following vehicles will be free once the service update is live: - Fighter: Aegis Gladius - Multi-crew: Anvil Paladin - Racing: Mirai Razor - Gravlev: C.O. HoverQuad - Heavy: Crusader C2 Hercules Starlifter  You'll also still have a free stock Tank and Gravlev for game modes for these. (ie Grav Race & Tank Royale)  Behring are also sponsoring Arena Commander this season, featuring some of their ballistic weapons for free across the module: - Behring S-38 Pistol - Behring BR-2 Shotgun - Behring P8-SC SMG - Behring P4-AR Rifle - Behring FS-9 LMG - Behring P6-LR Sniper Rifle  Reminder to check out Single Weapon Elimination each patch to get a hands on with new weapons and gear!   When the service updates the following vehicles will be available for rent, where they weren’t previously: - MISC Hull B - RSI Aurora Mk2 - RSI Hermes - RSI Apollo Medivac - RSI Apollo Triage - RSI Perseus - RSI Salvation - DRAKE Clipper - DRAKE Golem OX - Greycat MDC - Greycat UTV - Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf - Anvil Paladin - Esperia Stinger - Grey's Shiv  AC rentals now also persist across patches, reminder that you can "Extend Rental" to keep them longer.   I also want to reiterate that we are not a fan of the rental system in its current state, whilst that menu being Flash does limit things somewhat I will be investigating quick ways to improve the system for 4.10, one example being having a much longer initial rental period. For now my team is primarily focused on supporting the PU & SC1.0 with some pretty cool and important features (Transport, Radar/Scanning, Instancing and soon Freight Elevators & Hangars) but I will be reviewing some of the top issues in AC and seeing if there’s anything we can do to make the experience better.

title: Spectrum Redesign: Phase 1 Now Live
summary: Hi everyone,  The first phase of the new Spectrum redesign is now live!  This update introduces a cleaner, more modern experience designed to make Spectrum easier to navigate, easier to read, and better suited to the community it serves. Phase 1 lays the foundation, and this is only the beginning. We’ll continue refining and expanding Spectrum in the updates ahead.   What's New in Phase 1 You’ll notice Spectrum looks a little different today. Phase 1 refreshes the core experience with an updated layout, a redesigned sidebar for communities, bookmarks, and navigation, and updates to the Star Citizen community page. A New Home for Your Direct Messages Direct Messages now have a dedicated panel accessible from the top navigation bar, keeping your conversations just one click away wherever you are on Spectrum. Spectrum on Mobile, Refreshed Spectrum’s mobile experience has also received a refresh, with a dedicated navigation bar that keeps key destinations within easy reach. Community pages and lobbies are now easier to browse, with a cleaner experience that feels more consistent with desktop. This is Just the Beginning Phase 1 lays the foundation. Throughout 2026, we’ll continue rolling out the redesign across Spectrum, with threads and messages coming next.  This is about more than a new look. Each phase will introduce meaningful quality-of-life improvements, including better Markdown support, richer formatting options, and more ways to bring structure and personality to your posts.  We want Spectrum to be a place you enjoy contributing to, not just catching up on. title: Re: See how easy it is to get engaging and meaningful PvP, CIG?
summary: Howdy. I worked on this. I do most of the sandbox commodity prices, trade routes, etc.  First off, I'm glad you like the new route. I've been working on getting momentum to try something like this for a while.  Ever since the Osoian hide route went pretty well. I've been "stalking" Ashland in-game for a few days now, you may or may not have killed me, stolen my Elespo, had your stuff stolen by me, or hit me with a railgun. (I'm usually in a Titan or a Zues.)  I am proud to say, I have lost much more UEC than I gained since the patch dropped, and I regret nothing.  I always prefer communicating more with y'all about the reasoning and goals behind what we do. So lets do that:  CIG I implore you to continue to add commodities around the various POIs of Pyro that have ROI’s high enough to draw players there.  This unfortunately isn't a "infinite good content" faucet. Routes like this hit diminishing returns pretty fast. I want these locations to be a hotbed of danger and death. That's an intentional design goal. I want somewhere that players who log into the game and feel like they are hungry to shoot someone down can go reliably and find others who knowingly are willing to risk that.  Not only because that gives them the gameplay they desire, but because it keeps more of them out of the low profit routing lanes.  Player-bases aren't exactly zero-sum, but they aren't that far away from it either, the more predators at the watering hole, the more prey that aren't at the watering hole can feel safer.   If we add too many of these high ROI options, then that concentration wanes, and part of the risk that makes it work in the sandbox balance to allow such high ROI falls off.   We can definitely add some more in the future, but the main element that we'd need to add first, is a better way in-game for traders and pirates both to discover the current prices, and how much they have shifted via supply and demand. (on this note, I agree with @TheTechnobear)  In specific, I'd really like to add an interstellar route that only sells 24 SCU crates exclusively, so we can push for more large ship sandbox gameplay to happen around there.   (As always, a reminder to everyone, I don't speak for the whole company, please don't snip my comments out of context and post them on reddit. At the very least, get them in-context this time.)

title: Re: See how easy it is to get engaging and meaningful PvP, CIG?
summary: dont care if CIG leaves this and ppl keep bonking each other. At least they are somewhere else from where i am. Its a s*** magnet. That was quite literally part of the design.   I personally play sometimes in a group and love pvp, but also sometimes when I'm playing on my own, I just want to run a trade route that I feel confident won't be jumped. That's one of the benefits of having multiple different ROI brackets for trading.   The goal here is to give the player who like high-stakes pvp and high risk reward situations a place to do so, and as a result, to sponge a portion of them away from jumping people on low ROI routes.   I don't think we've completely succeeded on that front with just this route. Nor do I necessarily want to succeed 100% on this front. But I do think it's shown to be an improvement for the game.

title: Re: See how easy it is to get engaging and meaningful PvP, CIG?
summary: I agree.    In some ways, I do think overall operating costs for combat need to go up.   My dream scenario would be that players who are more focused on just shooting down ships more than actual piracy burn through money to do so, and then end up feeling pressured to actually make some profit themselves to recoup their losses. That's a tough balance point to reach right now without also putting extra pressure on the people who's ships randomly explode on take off.   But in the current situation, attempting to actually pirate people is usually more costly and risky than just attacking prey on sight. Which isn't a good long term state for the sandbox.

summary: Mostly because the PRTL price being that much of an outlier was an input error on my end.  You will notice that another commodity was about 10x below it's current price during the patches that PRTL was about 10x what it is now. PRTL got the extra 0 that another resource was supposed to get.   Partilium is still actually pretty high up there for it's Per SCU profit lines, but when it was 10x it was cannibalizing a lot of other routes, and more importantly, I'd put in the volumes at it's buy locations with a focus for it being a high-value option for smaller-scale cargo ships in pyro. But the actual pricelines were pulling ships that were much much larger away from the resources that make more sense for those ships.   All things working correctly, I would prefer to try and nudge the path of least resistance for players in a way that it's less likely that a Titan or Cutty will have to deal with an Idris pirating it for it's 2 SCU of cargo. But the pricelines of PRTL at that time (and the idris rampancy) led to that situation happening fairly often.

title: [Wave 1] Star Citizen Alpha 4.10 PTU Patch Notes 12335477
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.10 Alpha Patch 4.10 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.0-PTU.12335477     Audience: Wave 1     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases Instanced Siege of Orison Hydrogen Fuel Balance Arlington Lever Action Rifle Known Issues     PU - Multi-System - ASOP / UI / Locations - Vehicle remains in claim status after insurance claim or free loadout selection (Could become marked as captured and require a recopy to PTU)     PU - Multisystem - ASOP Terminal / UI / Location - Claim timer for Insured and Free loadout is too long     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Missions / Instancing - There is a chance that the force field gate with the "STANDBY" label at Overworld will not open     PU - Nyx - Battaglia - Repeatables - Mission Content / AI / Narrative / Dialogue - Battaglia does not go through generic flow of Repeatable missions if they are available to the player (currently blocks mission 3)     PU - Instancing / Locations / UI - Elevator to instance moves after noticeable delay after pressing the elevator button to the instance     PU - Stanton - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the second forcefield when the Main instance fully streams in     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Performance / Mission / Location - Severe performance dip approaching Solanki platform     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - ARGO ATLS IKTI - Ground Vehicle / Physics / Physical Proxy - The IKTI can get stuck in the ground after falling from a great height Features & Gameplay Arlington Lever Action Rifle Hey Space cowboys, we've got something special for those who love the wild side, a lever action rifle from Hedeby Gunworks! Hedeby Gunworks you may recall from their salvo frag pistol, for those unfamiliar it's a high Calibur pistol that can be charged to freeze and shatter it's ammo into fragments. Taking their shattering technology, this versatile rifle can shift between a DMR and a shotgun! Whenever you shift fire mode, you'll also see the weapon itself shift and slide, allowing the projectile to shatter. You should be able to nicely 1 tap medium NPCs to the head and where better to do that in the new siege of orison!  You can find the Arlington in Siege of Orison, along with it's bespoke optic around the verse. Weight: Average Firemodes: Single (DMR) / Single (Shotgun) Damage: 70 / 12.5 (8 Pellets) Projectile Velocity: 550 / 300 Aim down Sight Time: 0.15 RPM: 85 Mag size:  20  Technical & Bugfixes - Siege of Orison performance fixes Potential Fix: Fixed ore deposit kiosks always failing the transaction, preventing players from completing ore sales. Potential Fix: Fixed the inventory category filter menu getting stuck open, and ensured other context menus close properly when it is opened. Potential Fix: Fixed AI having delayed reactions to spotting players, and addressed missing reaction animations when AI perceive a threat. Potential Fix: Fixed an issue affecting NPCs at the Lorville landing zone gates that caused them to stand still. Potential Fix: Fixed smoke effects incorrectly playing during the Siege of Orison mission. Potential Fix: When dragging weapon attachments, the selection appears offset Potential Fix: Fixed the rummage pose animation on the Arlington rifle so the weapon's magazine/arm displays correctly. Potential Fix: Fixed a performance issue related to tractor beam usage at an Orison-area location during Siege of Orison. Potential Fix: Fixed a VFX preloading issue affecting optimization.

For full contest rules and to see some of the amazing submissions so far, please head over to the official Ship Showdown page.   Winning Conditions The CIG jury will judge your submissions on: Rule adherence Quality Creativity Aesthetic composition  Dates The submission period will end on Friday, August 14, 2026, 20:00 UTC.   Prizes Each of the following submissions that meet all entry requirements and are selected by the judges will receive a Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf in-game ship with Lifetime Insurance:  10 submissions on the Community Hub 5 submissions on X (Twitter)  Let the battles begin!

title: Ship Showdown 2956 - Phase 1: Vesselmania Begins!
summary: Ding ding ding, Citizens.  Ship Showdown 2956 is officially underway, and the 'verse is ringside for the biggest throwdown yet in the clash for aerospace supremacy! Last year, the Polaris did the unthinkable and knocked every fan favorite off the podium to claim the crown. The Asgard, Zeus ES, and Gladiator stood in the ring with it, but the Polaris left as the last one standing. Now it's back to defend its title, and the whole 'verse is lining up to get a shot at the champ. To kick off the throwdown, we're bringing last year's Final Four back for a victory lap from July 28 through August 3 at 20:00 UTC.  The only question that matters: does the Polaris keep the belt, or does a new challenger take it?  Ship Showdown runs July 28 through September 2, to crown the most beloved flyable or drivable vehicle in the 'verse. There are epic ships to win, a Free Fly featuring the Elite Eight, exclusive Best in Show paints, in-game manufacturer-themed coins for the Final Four, and an in-game coin case to display them in - plus a special champion's prize for this year's Undisputed Champion of the 'Verse.   YOU call the shots. The fight starts now with Phase 1 of Ship Showdown!    Welcome to Ship Showdown 2956 - Phase 1 July 28 through August 14  Phase 1 is where you throw your weight behind your beloved. Back your favorite flyable or drivable vehicle with an original creation, any medium, any style, as long as it's got your champion's name on it. Write a fight song, build a model, land a screenshot that stops the scroll, cut a hype trailer, or go full send and build the ship for real.  Post your creation to the Community Hub or on X using #StarCitizen and #ShipShowdown by August 14 @ 20:00 UTC.  But this isn't just a creativity contest, you've got to put in the work too. Flight and drive time, hauling, mining, salvaging, combat, it all counts toward your champion's shot at the Sweet 16. Take your Reclaimer into the scrapping fields, haul freight in your RAFT, or just fly your favorite ride across Stanton like there's a title on the line. Because there is.  Need some inspiration? Check out the standout entries from Ship Showdowns past. The top 16 vehicles with the most heat move on to Ship Showdown Phase 2 - the Live Showdown (from August 18 through September 2), going toe to toe in daily bracket-style smackdowns until only one is left standing. To keep it a fair fight, the field splits into distinct ship divisions: :package: Freighter (Transport) :motorway: Road Warrior (Ground Vehicles) :compass: Pathfinder (Exploration) :footprints: Underdog (The Little Ones) :gear: Heavy Duty (Industrial) :gun: Run & Gun (Combat) :alien: Eclectic Exotic (Alien) :boom: Big Hitters (Warships)   The top ten entries on the Community Hub and top five on X will each win a L-22 Alpha Wolf with in-game Lifetime Insurance.  Phase 1 is all about making noise for your favorite flyable or drivable vehicle, so take it out for a spin (or ten), and upvote, like, and reshare any content on the Community Hub or X (don't forget the hashtags mentioned above!) featuring the vehicle you want to see advance to Phase 2 and the Top 16. Plus, the Elite Eight will be free to test-fly starting August 26!   Beloved but benched Every fight's got rules, and this one's no different. The following ships and vehicles are sitting this one out and are not eligible for voting: Esperia Glaive, Vanduul Scythe, CNOU Mustang Omega, Aegis Sabre Raven, Greycat PTV, and Argo ATLS GEO IKTI (all variants).  Not fully sidelined: the Aegis Idris.  We know it's got a devoted following, and this year it's eligible to compete the whole way, Phase 1 straight through to the championship. However, due to the performance impact, the Idris WILL NOT be part of the Free Fly should it advance to the Elite Eight.   The Final Four will get exclusive Best in Show paints and in-game manufacturer-themed coins and a coin case, but the ultimate winner will also receive a special in-game champion's bomber jacket, all distributed at this year's Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. And, more importantly, a whole year of bragging rights. For all the details on Ship Showdown, the full contest rules, and to see the submissions so far, head over to the Ship Showdown hub.  One more thing... Everyone who casts a vote each day during Phase 2 of Ship Showdown's daily head-to-head battles earns a commemorative Ship Showdown 2956 Spectrum badge, because you were ringside for the whole fight. Ready to see history made?  The bell has rung.

title: Re: See how easy it is to get engaging and meaningful PvP, CIG?
summary: The missing piece, in my opinion, is information. I'm pretty sure I've said this on record before.    I really want to give players more in game information, The lack of information for traders in the game right now is not enjoyable, it doesn't serve a purpose.  I don't necessarily want 100% real time prices at all locations shown to all players. I do understand why lots of people think they want this. But perfect information gameplay is quite rarely good for supporting a meta, and at some level there will always be a meta between pirates, traders, and other traders competing for the same good prices. Instead of removing that meta, we can just make it fun instead.

title: Foundation Festival 2026 Has Begun!
summary: Foundation Festival is all about spotlighting what makes the Star Citizen community stand out: a commitment to collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and helping others find their footing among the stars. This year, we're celebrating Foundation Festival from now through August 12 with a Referral Bonus, rewards for those using the newly upgraded Guide System, and Twitch Drops for tuning into your favorite participating streamers! Got friends who've never flown before? There is also a Free Fly running through August 10.  If it's your first time in the 'verse, our refreshed Welcome Hub is a great launchpad with a collection of key resources to help you get off the ground and into the action.   But if you’re looking for a more personal way to connect, learn, or lend a hand, the Guide System is the perfect place to start.  Guides are Star Citizen’s ambassadors and, often, the first friendly face new players meet in Star Citizen. With so much to see, learn, and explore, the 'verse can feel a little daunting at first. That's where Guides come in. As a Guide, you can carry the torch, offering light, support, and experience to help others find their way. As a Recruit, teaming up with a veteran player can turn uncertain first steps into confident strides. And during this year's Foundation Festival, there are plenty of opportunities for both those lighting the path and those stepping onto it for the first time to earn epic rewards.  From July 29 through August 12, every Guide who uses the Guide System will automatically earn Foundation Festival-themed rewards. The more guide sessions you complete (or the more categories you help with), the more you'll rack up.  1 session gets you a beanie bundle. Complete 2 sessions and you'll add a hat to that. 3 sessions unlock everything above, plus a brand-new Foundation Festival armor (its in-game look is still catching up and will match the design pictured below in an upcoming patch).   Please note that while rewards will be distributed throughout Foundation Festival, it can take some time for items to show up in your hangar. A successful guide session is one that lasts at least 30 minutes and ends with a verified Endorsement* from the Recruit. Only sessions that meet both criteria will count toward Foundation Festival rewards. * Recruits (the ones requesting a Guide) will receive a message prompt after a successful session, asking them to verify the Guide and confirm the tutorial category completed. This prompt will appear via Private Message on Spectrum.  Heads up! If you already own one of the rewards, you won't be able to receive it a second time. Also, please remember that we can monitor and verify all Guide interactions and disqualify players attempting to game the system. In addition to the above rewards, those who lend a hand (or reach out for one) will be rewarded with Foundation Festival-themed ship liveries honoring each tutorial path. Only one paint is awarded per guide category (for both the Guide and the Recruit), but you can earn up to thirteen in total by completing all thirteen categories. Rewards are determined by the category endorsed by the Recruit at the end of the session. Check below to see which livery goes with which category: Beginner Basics: Anvil Arrow Foundation Festival Paint Vehicle Combat: Aegis Gladius Foundation Festival Paint FPS Combat: Anvil Valkyrie Foundation Festival Paint Mining: MISC Prospector Foundation Festival Paint Salvaging: Drake Vulture Foundation Festival Paint Missions & Reputation: Drake Cutlass Black Foundation Festival Paint Trading: Drake Caterpillar Foundation Festival Paint Medical: Drake Cutlass Red Foundation Festival Paint Racing: Mirai Razor Foundation Festival Paint Refueling: MISC Starfarer Foundation Festival Paint Touring: Origin 600i Touring Foundation Festival Paint Miscellaneous: Crusader Mercury Star Runner Foundation Festival Paint Refresher Basics: RSI Aurora Mk II Paint (New! :fire:) Head over to the Guide Hub to get started! Thank you to everyone who goes the extra mile to make this community special: the ones mentoring new pilots, flying wing for someone they've just met, or answering the same question on Spectrum for the tenth time without losing patience.   Happy Foundation Festival!

title: Roadmap Roundup - July 29, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team Release View Alpha 4.10  The following cards have been set to Committed. Super Heavy Combat "BUL-H4" Armor Instancing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements Siege of Orison Fuel Tanks and Consumption Rebalance New Wikelo Ship Offerings Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG Hedeby Gunworks "Arlington" Lever Action Rifle New Weapon Attachment: Hedeby Gunworks S2 Optic Mission Giver: Recco Battaglia remains Tentative while the team continues implementing her and her missions for a future Alpha 4.10 PTU build.   Alpha 4.10 is currently available in Wave 1, and the teams are eager to hear your feedback as development continues!  Read the Patch Notes to learn more about what's included in Alpha 4.10, test the currently available features in the PTU, then visit the dedicated Feedback threads to share your thoughts on each feature as they're introduced and refined throughout upcoming PTU builds.

summary: No it's not directly my ownership, but it sure does negatively affect the work I do when elevators break.   Best I can say is that even though I know it feels like you are just spitting into the ocean, using the issue council to report these and adding details genuinely does help us push to fix problems.   Especially when it seems like the problems are more frequent in areas with server health concerns as those are the hardest to run backend checks on, because they don't break as often in dev/testing environments.

title: Re: See how easy it is to get engaging and meaningful PvP, CIG?
summary: Disclaimer, Obviously I'm not working on S2A combat balance, so my direct input is limited. Long term i think this is more of an actual balance issue and not purely economics.  That being said. There are a few more subtle changes I can look into that I do have direct input on.  For one, although we do try to keep special weapon ammo pretty limited...  Chawlas and Ashland sure have been getting shot and bombed from the sky a lot, haven't they? I think it would make a lot of sense for them to start ordering and selling a bit of Animus and Scourge ammo for a good price to the brave defenders there... Don't you?  As for bomb prices... those don't really feel right to me at the moment. We will do some more math and look at them.

title: Re: RSI Launcher 2.15.4 Release Notes
summary: Hello @CyVan !   Thank you for your feedback.  We agree that for a proper chat you need to click links or select text. We are working on making text selection a reality soon. For all the other things that are needed in chat, we are going to integrate them once we connect Spectrum to the game. When you get in a Guide chat, you are in a guide session, so we automatically remove you from the list of available guides. So you don't need to turn off your availability. Good point. We'll adjust that. At the moment, the quickest way to get to the Spectrum Guide system is to click on the guide system cards (one is under the Community tab, the other is under the New Player tab). It is not ideal.

summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.10 Alpha Patch 4.10 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.0-PTU.12373313     Audience: All Waves     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus     Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases     Instanced Siege of Orison     Hydrogen Fuel Balance     Arlington Lever Action Rifle     Orison Relief Support     Recco Battaglia returns     Wikelo Updates Known Issues     PU - ORS - Missions / MobiGlas - The mission Deliver Medical Aid are missing on the mobiGlas     PU - ORS - Missions / Crafting - Unable to obtain the TH-01 Propulsor blueprint     PU - Nyx - Battaglia - Repeatables - Mission Content / AI / Narrative / Dialogue - Battaglia does not go through generic flow of Repeatable missions if they are available to the player (currently blocks mission 3)     PU - Instancing / Locations / UI - Elevator to instance moves after noticeable delay after pressing the elevator button to the instance     PU - Stanton - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the second forcefield when the Main instance fully streams in     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Performance / Mission / Location - Severe performance dip approaching Solanki platform     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - ARGO ATLS IKTI - Ground Vehicle / Physics / Physical Proxy - The IKTI can get stuck in the ground after falling from a great height Features & Gameplay Recco Battaglia Story Missions We have made the Battaglia story missions unlock sequentially one after the next without any rep gain required for easier testing.  Ship & Module Availability Added/removed the following ships and modules to in-game shops: Removed Aurora Mk1's from Shops Added Aurora Mk2 as a replacement to Mk1's at locations where relevant Added Aurora Mk2 Cargo and Missile modules to various locations including cargo offices, pyro trader outposts, and Teach's item kiosk Added Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf to Astro Armada Added MISC Hull B to New Deal and Teach's Added Drake Golem OX to Pyro Station Dealerships and New Deal Added Greycat UTV to Pyro Station Dealerships and Astro Armada Technical & Bugfixes Potential Fix: Contracts that grant item rewards can no longer be shared with other players. Potential Fix: A locker in a Battaglia location has been repositioned away from a doorway to prevent players clipping into it. Potential Fix: Mission progression in the Missing Persons mission could stall Potential Fix: Battaglia mining objectives now track progress against the mineable entity itself rather than the surrounding action area, improving reliability when mining objective rocks. Potential Fix: Battaglia scanning objectives could stop functioning entirely if an asteroid was spawned during the objective. The scanning module no longer shuts down in this situation. Potential Fix: Refueling missions could advance before refueling was complete. Potential Fix: Contested Zone NPCs were not spawning armed and now correctly receive a pistol. Potential Fix: The vendor at Cordrys in Levski was not standing at his counter correctly.

title: [All Waves] Star Citizen Alpha 4.10 PTU Patch Notes 12388491
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.10 Alpha Patch 4.10 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.0-PTU.12388491     Audience: All Waves     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus     Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases     Instanced Siege of Orison     Hydrogen Fuel Balance Quantum Drive Balance     Arlington Lever Action Rifle     Orison Relief Support     Recco Battaglia returns     Wikelo Updates Known Issues     PU - Inventory / UI - Double-clicking equippable items failed to equip them to empty equipment slots     PU - ORS - Missions / MobiGlas - The mission Deliver Medical Aid are missing on the mobiGlas     PU - Instancing / Locations / UI - Elevator to instance moves after noticeable delay after pressing the elevator button to the instance     PU - Stanton - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the second forcefield when the Main instance fully streams in     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Performance / Mission / Location - Severe performance dip approaching Solanki platform     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - ARGO ATLS IKTI - Ground Vehicle / Physics / Physical Proxy - The IKTI can get stuck in the ground after falling from a great height Features & Gameplay Quantum Drive Balance We have balanced the acceleration and top speeds of all quantum drives and added variation to cooldown times, spool up times, and interdiction effect times. This should reduce the average travel time by roughly ~22% with the intention for small Quantum drives to have high acceleration but slow top speed and larger quantum drives to have slower acceleration but higher top speeds.  Technical & Bugfixes - Fixed 1 Client Crash Potential Fix: Mission giver state changes during Battaglia story missions were not being executed correctly, affecting mission flow, AI behavior, and associated UI. Potential Fix: Clicking the tracking mission on starmap zooms in too much on mission location. Potential Fix: The C788 was dealing too much damage. Its damage output has been reduced and its explosion damage removed. Potential Fix: A drastic performance drop when moving the UI. Potential Fix: Mission failure comms notifications were not displaying correctly on Battaglia story missions and during the board ship objective. Potential Fix: The Warehouse Key needed to complete the code step in the "Welcome to Nyx" mission was broken and blocked mission completion. Potential Fix: A Battaglia delivery objective could not be completed. The amount of materials required to hand in has been reduced. Potential Fix: Assorted issues with the Battaglia repeatable missions and Story 3 in Nyx, covering mission content, AI, narrative, and dialogue. Potential Fix: The shopping card was invisible when using the shopping AR interface at Centermass.

summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.10 Alpha Patch 4.10 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.0-PTU.12399239     Audience: All Waves     Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only     Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus     Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases     Instanced Siege of Orison     Hydrogen Fuel Balance     Quantum Drive Balance     Arlington Lever Action Rifle     Orison Relief Support     Recco Battaglia returns (reputation speed increase for PTU testing)     Wikelo Updates Known Issues     PU - Inventory / UI - Double-clicking equippable items failed to equip them to empty equipment slots     PU - ORS - Missions / MobiGlas - The mission Deliver Medical Aid are missing on the mobiGlas     PU - Instancing / Locations / UI - Elevator to instance moves after noticeable delay after pressing the elevator button to the instance     PU - Stanton - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the second forcefield when the Main instance fully streams in     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - Performance / Mission / Location - Severe performance dip approaching Solanki platform     PU - Stanton - Siege of Orison - ARGO ATLS IKTI - Ground Vehicle / Physics / Physical Proxy - The IKTI can get stuck in the ground after falling from a great height  Features & Gameplay Quantum Drive Spool Time Rebalance Spool up times have been adjusted across all quantum drives, this includes most drives receiving a 2-3x longer spool up while a smaller amount have had their spool times reduced slightly.   Ballistic Gatling S3 Damage Ballistic Gatling S3 damage increased to be effective against ships of the same size class as it was previously dealing insufficient damage to be viable in its intended role Projectile damage increased from 19 to 32 Recco Battaglia Story Mission Rewards Mining modules added to the component reward pool for Battaglia story mission ship rewards Ore pod rewards from Story Mission 3 now correctly appear in the crafting fabricator Additional Updates ADS no longer triggers on the fire extinguisher when right-clicking while firing; right-click now has no function while using the extinguisher, matching the correct design intent Performance Update: Fire hazard VFX optimized to reduce CPU overhead Performance Update: Off-screen particle emitters that were spawned as on-screen emitters now correctly expire and are deleted, preventing accumulation of invisible particles that were causing performance degradation over time  Bug Fixes & Technical - Fixed 1 Client Crash Potential Fix: Players becoming stuck in a respawn queue when multiple players die simultaneously inside an instanced zone, requiring a game restart to resolve Potential Fix: Entities and mechanics inside instanced zones incorrectly emitting events into restricted areas of the parent zone, causing unintended triggers outside the instance boundary Potential Fix: Battaglia Story Mission 3 blueprint rewards displaying as placeholder text and not appearing in the crafting fabricator Potential Fix: Battaglia mission hard drives displaying as placeholder text instead of their correct item name Potential Fix: Instance service calls being routed through the wrong DGS when a DGS that did not originally ensure the instance tried to send heartbeats or other service calls, causing instance stability issues Potential Fix: Battaglia HotCold proximity tracker failing to locate the target after extended searching; the activation range now doubles after five minutes if the target has not been found

the recipe now uses a base ATLS with additional components Potential Fix: Aegis Hammerhead Nightbreak livery obscuring rear turret visibility due to incorrect material ID on the turret interior glass Potential Fix: Jericho Rocket Pod rockets being invisible with no visible trail or VFX until the moment of impact Potential Fix: Mirai Guardian MX laser damage resistance values not updated to the correct standard following the Vehicle Armor feature introduction, making it incorrectly vulnerable to energy weapons

title: Roadmap Roundup - August 12, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!  Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.  The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.  Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.  With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!  -CIG Community Team Release View Alpha 4.11 Nyx I Nyx I is a coreless planet that orbits closest to the sun in the Nyx system. Once considered impossible to terraform, Nyx I has undergone a drastic transformation thanks to new experimental technology developed by Genesis Terraforming and now features a robust ecosphere capable of supporting a wide diversity of life. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Starchitect Mission Pack Implementing new sandbox missions across sprawling planetary locations designed to keep players planetside for longer, with focus on more localized objectives. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Genesis: Planet Tech v5 Implementing Planet Tech V5, a complete rework of how planets are built, populated, and rendered. Introducing emergent biomes driven by realistic physical properties, and scattering plants and rocks according to their natural behaviour, reworking terrain shading across materials like sand, dirt, rock, and snow, and moving generation and spawning to the GPU to support denser environments with improved rendering performance. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Genesis: Starchitect Implementing Starchitect, a new procedural world-building system that automatically scatters sectors, clusters, and locations across planetary bodies while constructing locations from modular tiles. Using Genesis data to identify suitable placement for game objects, Starchitect introduces a new workflow for populating planets and building large-scale locations across an expanding universe. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Genesis: Population Manager Implementing the Population Manager tech. Its primary goal is to load balance the server population and create inhabitants appropriate to their local environment, while enabling more complex interactions between agents focused on a dynamic context. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Starchitect POIs Implementing new ground locations owned by various factions, offering a variety of procedurally generated combinations of building compositions. These will support a wide variety of mission archetypes and gameplay loops. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative. Heavy Combat Armor Implementing a heavy combat armor in the persistent universe. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Character Customization Update (Brows) Implementing three new eyebrow styles and updating six existing options to bring them up to the current visual quality standard. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG Implementing the Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG, a medium-range weapon that builds heat through sustained fire before unleashing devastating superheated plasma projectiles with its alternate fire mode. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  Kastak Arms "Hellion" Pistol Implementing the Hellion Plasma Pistol, a high-velocity plasma weapon that creates hazardous impact zones, allowing operators to rapidly deploy multiple areas of denial across the battlefield. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.  New Wikelo Ship Offerings: Tiburon Adding an Aegis Tiburon with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts. :scroll: This card has been set to Tentative.
