title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hello everyone!  Star Citizen 4.10 is on the horizon and we've got a bunch of VR updates for you again. I've also updated my original post to include these.  For any comments, suggestions or anything else regarding these updates please reply to my message here.  Features Holographic elements (ship radars, the New Babbage greeter, Area18 holograms and more) now render correctly in VR. Introduced a new global fading system, offering greater flexibility and full VR support. Added a fade transition when entering and exiting theater mode, configurable via r_StereoTheaterModeFadeTime. Implemented XR_EXT_user_presence support for dynamic stereo switching, extending compatibility to any headset supporting this extension, including SteamVR. Replaced g_headtracking_hmd_fpsResetDistance with g_headtracking_hmd_fpsHeadBoundaryDistance, introducing a new shader-based fade effect in place of the previous hard reset. The effect now begins at 0.4m (up from the previous 0.2m reset threshold) and gradually intensifies. This effect also now triggers by default whenever the camera clips through an object, preventing players from seeing through walls in first person. Bug Fixes Fixed an issue where opening kiosks interfered with the player animation system causing unintended player movement. Resolved a recurring shadow flickering issue where shadows would stop following the camera. Fixed head tracking incorrectly applying to RTT cameras (e.g., comm calls). Fixed third-person camera collision in VR when the camera position was adjusted. VRAM usage in the graphics menu now correctly reflects usage in VR. Disabled chromatic aberration in VR. Fixed multi-choice selection in VR (e.g., holo greeter in New Babbage, which is now visible). Fixed an issue where GForce blink effects were applied independently to each eye instead of in sync.

title: Ship Showdown 2956 - Phase 2: The Live Showdown!
summary: Hey y'all!   The Ship Showdown Phase 1 contest is in the books, and from all of the incredible entries, 16 participants have emerged from the Vesselmania gauntlet as your favorites. Now the real battle to be champion begins in Phase 2: The Live Showdown!  For each matchup, two ships enter, one ship leaves — and only you can decide the outcome of who moves on to the Elite Eight, with one ship or vehicle ultimately carving a path to be crowned this year's champion. Choose wisely, as in celebration of their victories, your Elite Eight will be available for a Free Fly for players starting August 26! Please note that due to its performance impact, the Idris will not be part of the Free Fly should it advance to the Elite Eight.  Phase 2: Head-to-Head Matches August 18: :package: Freighter Division (Transport) - Drake Ironclad Assault vs. RSI Hermes August 19: :blue_car: Road Warrior (Ground Vehicles) - Greycat UTV vs. Greycat MTC August 20: :compass: Pathfinder (Exploration) - Drake Corsair vs. Anvil Carrack August 21: :footprints: Underdog (The Little Ones) - Drake Clipper vs. RSI Aurora Mk II August 22: :gear: Heavy Duty (Industrial) - Argo MOLE vs. Aegis Reclaimer August 23: :gun: Run & Gun (Combat) - Origin M80 vs. Grey's Market Shiv August 24: :alien: Eclectic Exotic (Alien) - Gatac Railen vs. Esperia Prowler Utility August 25: :boom: Big Hitters (Warships) - RSI Perseus vs. Aegis Idris-P  Since the Idris-P made it all the way to the Top 16, we're making a limited number available during its head-to-head match starting on August 25. Stock will drop across six waves to cover as many global time zones as possible  Wave 1: August 25 - 1600 UTC Wave 2: August 25 - 2000 UTC Wave 3: August 26 - 0000 UTC Wave 4: August 26 - 0400 UTC Wave 5: August 26 - 0800 UTC Wave 6: August 26 - 1200 UTC  Don't forget, if you vote during every head-to-head matchup in Phase 2, you'll walk away with a commemorative Ship Showdown 2956 Spectrum badge in your account.   Will your favorite contender fight on, or be reduced to scrap? You decide. Keep in mind that players who own any of the Final Four competitors as of Intergalactic Aerospace Expo later this year will also receive Best in Show paints, manufacturer-themed coins, and a coin case, with a manufacturer-themed bomber jacket going to backers of the ultimate champ.  So strap in, rev up, and cast your votes every day until phase 2 ends, to ensure your favorite makes it all the way to the win!

title: RSI Launcher 2.16 Release Notes
summary: Hello everyone,   Today, we are releasing the RSI Launcher 2.16.0  RSI Launcher can be found here:  https://install.robertsspaceindustries.com/rel/2/RSI%20Launcher-Setup-2.16.0.exe   In this version, we're fixing QoL issues and introducing a new visual feature:   When hovering on a specific card a video will display in the background. It is not visible for now but it will be when we release a new game patch. :gear: New features:    What's new in this release:  Video display on card hover. You can now select text and copy paste in the guide session chat.   :hammer_and_wrench: Fixed Issues:   LCH-3224: Guide panel now follows Accessibility settings. Comm-Links click on links fixed Horizontal scroll on guide proficiencies fixed LCH-3235: Black Box issue fixed.  Fixed issue on invisible status removed when entering game.   :bug: Known issues:      If you witness a black rectangle on the bottom right of your screen, please turn off the overlay notification in your notification settings.     Some users encounter a flickering Launcher background, which can be partially mitigated by turning off accessibility settings. Please refer to this comment for a potential fix: https://robertsspaceindustries.com/spectrum/community/SC/forum/1/thread/rsi-launcher-2-0-6-release-notes/7279512      The Launcher sometimes fails to create the StarCitizen/Live folders for some users, leading to Error 2000, Error 5008, or Error 5010. Try creating the folder manually and running the Launcher as an administrator.      LCH-1030: Launcher suppresses Screen Saver      LCH-1958: Never Ending Download loop. Please report the issue; we're having trouble reproducing it.      Users might encounter Desync with Language and Proficiencies while using the guide system both on Spectrum and in the Launcher at the same time.    :mega: RSI Issue Council - Launcher Project  https://issue-council.robertsspaceindustries.com/projects/LAUNCHER    Any additional feedback can be provided in this Spectrum Thread. title: PTU Stress Test, Alpha 4.10: Siege of Orison, Recco Battaglia, and... the Kruger Stingray?
summary: We're getting into the home stretch for Alpha 4.10, and we'd like to spend the rest of this week putting the PTU through its paces before we roll out to the Live servers.  We've got a number of fixes in, along with some additional backend logging to help us keep a better eye on things while you're playing. Now we want to put some real load on the areas we're most interested in seeing hold up.   In particular, we'd love to see you spend some time with: Siege of Orison Recco Battaglia Cargo Missions  As part of this final push, we're giving active PTU testers a chance to take the Kruger S-65 Stingray out for a spin. Those who receive access will be able to fly it for free through Sunday.   If you've already put substantial time into testing the PTU, you may find the Stingray available immediately with today's new build. If you're just getting started with the PTU today, spend some time playing the focused activities mentioned above (specific criteria will be outlined in the upcoming Patch Notes), and we'll be keeping an eye out for active players to grant access to the Stingray as well. Once it's available in your hangar, take it out for a spin and let us know what you think.   The main goal here is pretty straightforward: we want to find the things that are going to break when we put this in front of everyone on Live. If something feels off, breaks, gets weird, or just doesn't behave the way you think it should, let us know on Spectrum and the Issue Council.   Thanks for continuing to participate on the PTU, and we'll see you in-game!

If you're just getting started with the PTU today, spend some time playing the focused activities mentioned above (specific criteria will be outlined in the upcoming Patch Notes), and we'll be keeping an eye out for active players to grant access to the Stingray as well. The main goal here is pretty straightforward: we want to find the things that are going to break when we put this in front of everyone on Live. If something feels off, breaks, gets weird, or just doesn't behave the way you think it should, let us know on Spectrum and the Issue Council. Thanks for continuing to participate on the PTU, and we'll see you in-game!

title: [All Waves] Star Citizen Alpha 4.10 PTU Patch Notes 12488012
summary: Star Citizen Alpha Patch 4.10 Alpha Patch 4.10 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.0-PTU.12488012 Audience: All Waves Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only Long Term Persistence: Enabled Testing/Feedback Focus Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases Instanced Siege of Orison Hydrogen Fuel Balance Quantum Drive Balance Arlington Lever Action Rifle Orison Relief Support Recco Battaglia returns (Progression speed no longer enabled) Wikelo Inventory Updates Kruger S65 Stingray Known Issues PU - Instancing / Locations / UI - Elevator to instance moves after noticeable delay after pressing the elevator button to the instance PU - Stanton - Instancing / Locations / Performance -  The client will stall/freeze for a few seconds at the second forcefield when the Main instance fully streams in  Features & Updates Kruger S65 Stingray Armor health values updated following a balance pass   Bug Fixes & Technical - Fixed 1 Client Crash Potential Fix: Undocking from a ship mid-refuel causing external fuel tanks on the Starfarer to dump their entire fuel load rather than retaining it Potential Fix: Instance elevator on the Orison platform suddenly becoming uncallable for all party members, caused by authority assignment messages being dropped during entity streaming and hierarchy changes; multiple edge cases in the authority propagation system have been addressed Potential Fix: QV Breaker Stations in the Nyx Dungeon having no collision, causing players and items to fall through the floors and walls Potential Fix: MISC Starlite fuel nozzle failing to deploy, blocking it from docking with recipient ships for refueling contracts Potential Fix: Siege of Orison Command Center entrance airlock not resetting after a player died and respawned inside it, permanently sealing the entrance for all other players; additional fix covering the case where a player dies while the airlock is in the process of opening Potential Fix: Mouse clicks, weapon fire inputs, and UI button presses being lost or stuck, caused by a raw mouse input optimization incorrectly dropping legacy input events; the optimization has been reverted pending a rework. (This also restores significantly improved input reliability for players running under Wine/Proton) Potential Fix: ATC landing and takeoff hotkey not working, requiring players to use the comms menu instead Potential Fix: Buying any commodity at a kiosk locking the player out of purchasing additional commodities until the first purchase was removed via the freight elevator Potential Fix: Ships with landing gear connected beneath destroyed thrusters unable to be repaired at a repair terminal, as the transaction manager was incorrectly rejecting items that were parented to other items in the same repair request Potential Fix: Keycards carried by Nine Tails Elite NPCs spawning inside armor item slots rather than the backpack slot, making them invisible and impossible to loot without stripping the NPC's armor first Potential Fix: Fusebox lever animation inclusion file missing, causing the lever up and down animations to not play at runtime despite the animation data being present Potential Fix: Commodity kiosk showing the wrong delivery subtype in certain transactions, causing incorrect delivery destination selection

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: You need to reset your tracking. This happens in first person when your headposition is too far off its root position where it should be. The "godrays" indicate in what direction you should move your head to get back to its root position. This is a new system which replaced the old Tracking Reset. If you think it doesn't work like it is supposed to be please share some reproduction steps.
body_html: You need to reset your tracking. This happens in first person when your headposition is too far off its root position where it should be. The "godrays" indicate in what direction you should move your head to get back to its root position. This is a new system which replaced the old Tracking Reset. If you think it doesn't work like it is supposed to be please share some reproduction steps.
thread_title: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: This effect will not be removed. You can change the trigger distance by using g_headtracking_hmd_fpsHeadBoundaryDistance but it still triggers if the raycast from your headpos to the root position detects a hit. My guess is that the latter happens for whatever reason. I need some repro steps to investigate and fix this then.
body_html: This effect will not be removed. You can change the trigger distance by using g_headtracking_hmd_fpsHeadBoundaryDistance but it still triggers if the raycast from your headpos to the root position detects a hit. My guess is that the latter happens for whatever reason. I need some repro steps to investigate and fix this then.
thread_title: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)

title: [4.10 LIVE Feedback] Kruger S-65 Stingray
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

The Kruger S-65 Stingray, a medium fighter, has been made available to fly in the 'Verse! This is the first medium fighter in Kruger’s repertoire and holds all the allure of its classic aesthetic while morphing between silhouettes as it encounters the many facets of contemporary flight.

A feedback survey is available at: Kruger Stingray Survey Form. This survey will be open until Sep 30.

title: Re: QT Changes in 4.10, more than you think
summary: With Alpha 4.10, currently being deployed to the live servers, we are revisiting fuel tank capacities and consumption values across the ship roster.
body_html:
With Alpha 4.10, currently being deployed to the live servers, we are revisiting fuel tank capacities and consumption values across the ship roster.

The previous setup created several inconsistencies, with some ships carrying hydrogen tanks that were disproportionately large for their size while having comparatively small quantum fuel tanks. In some cases, the calculated tank capacities would have required tanks larger than the ships themselves. This update aims to make fuel capacities more logical and consistent while better reflecting each ship’s size, role, manufacturer, and intended gameplay.

Quantum Fuel Tanks

Quantum fuel tank capacities have generally been increased to better match the size and intended purpose of each ship.

Alongside these capacity changes, we have also reviewed how far ships can travel using their available quantum fuel and how much fuel is consumed by quantum drives of different sizes.

This pass takes several factors into account, including:

Ship size and archetype

Intended role and specialization

Manufacturer

Quantum drive size

Expected travel range

We have also incorporated feedback from the previous version of this balance that was tested during Alpha 4.9. Several issues reported during that testing period have been addressed as the updated balance returns in Alpha 4.10.

Overall, ships should now have quantum fuel capacities that feel more appropriate for their size and intended use. Let us know what you think in the dedicated Feedback thread!

Hydrogen Fuel Tanks

Hydrogen fuel tank capacities have also been reviewed across the ship roster.

As we continue adding more opportunities for players to participate in refueling gameplay, it became important to revisit the previous approach to hydrogen fuel balance.

Previously, tank capacities could vary significantly between ships of a similar size or archetype. The new pass brings these values closer together while still accounting for the individual characteristics that make each ship unique.

Hydrogen fuel tank sizes have generally been reduced or normalized, but this does not mean ships will spend less time in normal flight. Fuel consumption has been adjusted alongside tank capacity so that the overall amount of time a ship can remain airborne should remain broadly similar. We're aiming to make the numbers make sense without changing how the ships feel to fly.

These adjustments should also reduce the large discrepancy between hydrogen and quantum fuel capacities, creating a more consistent foundation for refueling gameplay as we continue to work on future systems.

Note that we've also rebalanced refueling missions to account for the updated fuel consumption and tank capacity values coming with Alpha 4.10.

The mission pool has also received additional tuning to prevent inappropriate targets, such as the Idris, from appearing in refueling contracts.

title: Updates to Pledge Gifting and Game Access
summary: Hey there,
body_html:
Hey there,

As we continue preparing for the launch of Squadron 42 and progressing toward Star Citizen 1.0, we’re taking the next step with a new Game Library system that gives games a clear, permanent place within each account. As part of this transition, we’re making updates to pledge gifting and game access. We’re sharing these details early so everyone knows what to expect when the changes take effect in October.

Gifting Changes

The following changes will apply only to pledges purchased after the new gifting system takes effect in October. Existing pledges will retain their current gifting functionality.

Pledges intended as gifts must be designated as such at the time of purchase.

A pledge designated as a gift cannot be used by the purchaser.

Once the recipient has received the gifted pledge, it may be upgraded normally using CCUs.

Game Access

When the new Game Library system launches on October 1, 2026:

One eligible pledge on each account will be designated as its primary Game Access pledge. This will be the account’s non-meltable pledge, or, if no non-meltable pledges are present, its oldest pledge.

The primary Game Access pledge will become permanently associated with the account and cannot be melted or gifted.

Any ships or vehicles included in the pledge may still be upgraded normally using Cross-Chassis Upgrades (CCUs).

Additional game packages and duplicate game copies will continue to function normally and may still be gifted where eligible.

Looking Ahead

These updates are part of the broader work underway to create a clearer and more consistent account experience for Squadron 42 and Star Citizen. We’ll share any additional information as we approach the new Game Library system’s rollout in October.

title: Re: Instancing Ideas for a Smoother Experience in the 'verse
summary: Put simply, Instancing lets us create multiple versions of the same location, so you and your party in Siege of Orison can have your own private space to explore and complete missions without anyone else getting in the way. Right now, when you take on Siege of Orison, you and your party of up to four courageous citizens hop into an elevator, pick your instance, and head to your own private waiting area. Once you pass through the forcefield, your adventure begins in your own version of the mission.
body_html:
Put simply, Instancing lets us create multiple versions of the same location, so you and your party in Siege of Orison can have your own private space to explore and complete missions without anyone else getting in the way. Right now, when you take on Siege of Orison, you and your party of up to four courageous citizens hop into an elevator, pick your instance, and head to your own private waiting area. Once you pass through the forcefield, your adventure begins in your own version of the mission.

We're planning to use instancing in locations where it makes sense, so you always get the full experience. You won't have to worry about showing up to a mission where the loot is gone or the action is already over. In the old Siege of Orison, it was easy to arrive late and miss out, but now, with instancing, you and your party can jump in and enjoy the whole mission from start to finish every time.

Now more specifically to touch on the points raised here, we don't always want players to seek out instances. There may be times in the future where you enter instances during the natural course of gameplay without even realizing it. The number of players in an instance can be anything we want them to be, and it can range anywhere from one player to hundreds, but the decision is based on what provides the best experience for the players at that specific location, for that specific content, be it PvE, PvP, or a mix of that; So we're not moving away from an "open living world", the tech will be used to support specific pieces of content that require it.

On the performance side, moving specific content into instances means we can put each one on its own Dedicated Game Server, which helps everything run smoother and takes some pressure off the main servers. We've also made plenty of improvements and optimizations during the Alpha 4.10 PTU cycle to make sure your experience is as great as we can. Thank you to those who participated in the stress tests :+1:

body_html:
Alpha Patch 4.10.1 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.1-PTU.12578875

Audience: All Waves

Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only

Long Term Persistence: Enabled

Testing/Feedback Focus

Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases

Orison Relief Support

Features & Updates

New Event: Orison Relief Support

In the wake of the Nine Tails attack on Orison, Crusader Industries is hosting a relief initiative to help rebuild the affected regions and upgrade their defenses. Players can take on a rotating slate of contracts through the mobiGlas and earn points toward a shared reward track that unlocks blueprints for new weapons and armor along the way.

Contract Types include:

Construction Aid (Cornerstone Developments): gather and deliver construction resources to Orison or Seraphim Station

Medical Aid Hauling (Covalex): collect medical supplies and iodine from New Babbage or Port Tressler and deliver them to Orison or Seraphim

Medical Aid Delivery (Ling): collect medical supplies and iodine from New Babbage or its rooftops and deliver them to Orison or the Orison rooftops

Crafted Aid (Cornerstone Developments): craft and deliver a batch of prototype thrusters

Ship Ambush (Foxwell): intercept and destroy hostile ships threatening supply lines

Ship Wave Attack (Foxwell): defend against waves of hostile ships in space combat

Eliminate All (Foxwell): clear out remaining Nine Tails from targeted outposts in FPS combat

Completing contracts earns points toward a single shared reward track. Rewards are distributed as blueprints unlocked along the track rather than individual mission payouts, covering three new FPS weapons and three new armor pieces.

Bug Fixes & Technical

Tonight's 4.10.1 build includes all the previous hotfixes don't in 4.10.0 including the latest nvidia driver crash fix.

An item limit has been added to the freight elevator platform to prevent the simultaneous unstowing of more cargo than the platform can handle, preventing server-side instability during high-volume cargo operations

Potential Fix: Armistice zones not active anywhere at Orison, allowing players to be freely attacked throughout the location; a zone system optimization has been applied and the issue is now being monitored for resolution

Potential Fix: Tactical Strike Group Full Strike missions not progressing past the initial "Go To Objective" phase

Potential Fix: Drake Clipper hull taking no damage across most of its surface due to multiple geometry proxies on the body and doors not being set up as individual parts; doors on the underside now correctly detach when destroyed

Potential Fix: Ground vehicles not entering soft death state when critically damaged, instead continuing to operate or destroying outright

Potential Fix: Ships delivered to personal hangars landing on the elevator platform incorrectly, causing the landing gear to clip through the floor when the ship detached from the elevator

Potential Fix: Refueling contract details in the mobiGlas showing the incorrect aUEC per SCU price for fuel

Potential Fix: Refueling intro missions listing quantum fuel as a required fuel type instead of hydrogen only

Potential Fix: Odyssey II Undersuit Alpha missing its necksock, causing a gap between the helmet and undersuit collar

Potential Fix: Weapon attachments missing from loot at DC Delving and other locations

summary: Alpha Patch 4.10.1 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.1-PTU.12625701
body_html:
Alpha Patch 4.10.1 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.1-PTU.12625701

Audience: All Waves

Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only

Long Term Persistence: Enabled

Testing/Feedback Focus

Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases

Orison Relief Support

Ship Hangar Elevator Flow

Tonight's build brings in a lot of technical updates to how the player hangar elevator retrieves and brings in ships. Let us know if you have any issues with ships failing to spawn, being offset on load, or any other issues encountered with retrieving and storing ships!

Features & Updates

Orison Relief Support

The event requirements for completion have been reduced by quite a lot in today's ptu. Blueprints have been removed from the Orison Relief Support reward track and are now direct rewards granted to your account. These should be attributed to your PTU account only when completing on PTU.

Freight Elevator

An item limit has been added to the freight elevator platform to prevent unstowing more individual items than the platform can handle

Hauling Contract Distribution

Cargo distribution across multiple pickup locations now accounts for SCU weight per location, producing more sensible splits and percentile-based cargo amounts corrected

Added error reporting for contracts where dropoff and pickup counts do not match to help track down any further issues with these.

BUG FIXES & TECHNICAL

Shard Recovery

Players who become stuck unable to connect to a shard, either because that shard is isolated or because their spawn repeatedly fails, are now automatically diverted to a healthy shard rather than looping on the failing one. This one is a tough test on PTU due to its nature so please let us know if you run into any issues getting locked to a shard!

Performance

Improved audio thread handling to reduce frame rate drops caused by repeated thread initialization

Better memory management for zone partition object page lists, reducing frequent allocation cycles

- We have further logging and are testing changes with Battaglia Story 2 and Story 3 contracts never being created on populated shards. Testing these out in tonight's build would be great

Potential Fix: Ships Delivered in Personal Hangars are not Properly Positioned and can be damaged

Potential Fix: ASOP Terminal unable to retrieve any vehicles due to a vehicle becoming permanently stuck in a "being stored" or "changing ships" state

Potential Fix: Ships getting stuck in "Moving to Storage" when the player streamed out of the hangar while the storing animation was still playing

Potential Fix: Freight elevator kiosk queuing a duplicate inventory request when opened while an unstow was still processing

Potential Fix: Orison Relief Support Wave 1 not spawning all hostile AI ships, leaving the objective incompletable

Potential Fix: Mendo Ren spawning without his correct weapon equipped

Potential Fix: Ground vehicles not entering the soft death state when critically damaged

Potential Fix: Drake Clipper taking no damage across most of its hull, with underside doors now correctly taking damage and detaching when destroyed

Potential Fix: ATC landing and takeoff hotkey not working, requiring players to use the comms menu instead

Potential Fix: Orison Relief Support ship spawn missions using an incorrect detach direction; mission balancing also adjusted

Potential Fix: Contracted cargo losing its contracted status

Potential Fix: Hauling contracts not refreshing their objective tokens

Potential Fix: Vehicle pilot compass showing an incorrect bearing compared to the FPS compass

Crash Fixes

2 Client Crashes Fixed: I'm testing listing out client crash technical reasons in case one of them happens to be a frequent specific crash a player is hitting constantly.

Potential Fix: Client crash in Matrix34_tpl::Determinant(). This is a UI interaction crash that could happen while moving the mouse over interactive UI (mobiGlas, kiosks, MFDs, the starmap, anything built on the Building Blocks system).

Potential Fix: Client crash in CComputeSkinningStage::Execute(), This is a rendering crash tied to characters or creatures being removed from a scene such as NPCs despawning.

We will be going over the ICs for related bug fixes from today's PTU build as well as discussions in this thread for issues that may be still occurring after a fix was put in.

https://issue-council.robertsspaceindustries.com/projects/STAR-CITIZEN

As always, we can't thank you all enough for all your help!

title: RSI Aurora Mk I Retirement Reminder
summary: Hey everyone,
body_html:
Hey everyone,

September 30, 2026 marks the official retirement of the RSI Aurora Mk I, bringing its production run to a close as RSI makes way for the newer RSI Aurora Mk II.

TL;DR: The Aurora Mk I will leave the Pledge Store on September 30. If you already have one in your hangar, it stays yours and remains fully playable and supported in-game.

We first announced the retirement of the Aurora Mk I back in March, providing a six-month sunset window for anyone who wanted to add this piece of RSI history to their fleet before production officially ends. We also covered the retirement plan in our Q&A: RSI Aurora, including what it means for those who already have one.

What is not changing:

If you already have an Aurora Mk I in your hangar, nothing changes about your ability to fly and use it.

The ship remains yours and will continue to be fully supported in-game, including repairs, refueling, maintenance, components, and general gameplay, much like the previously retired Anvil Hornet Mk I.

Additionally, as Star Citizen's development continues, we may introduce new ways to earn the Aurora Mk I in-game.

What is changing on September 30:

The Aurora Mk I will be removed from the Pledge Store.

Any unretrieved standalone ships, upgrades, or CCUs specifically involving the Aurora Mk I in your Buy Back queue will no longer be retrievable after the retirement date.

If you have any questions about the Aurora Mk I retirement or how it may affect you, please let us know in the comments below.

title: Orison Relief Support - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all,
body_html:
Hey y'all,

In the wake of vicious and unprovoked attacks by the Nine Tails gang on Orison’s platforms, and for the safety and security of the Stanton system as a whole, it has become vital that we begin efforts to rebuild immediately. In conjunction with several valiant support organizations, we are coordinating a widespread campaign to supply and secure relief efforts. With your contribution, we can restore Orison to its rightful glory.

We've put together answers to some of your common questions about Orison Relief Support below.

▲ What is the Orison Relief Support event?

Orison Relief Support is a new limited-time event arriving with Alpha 4.10.1: Orison Relief Support, where you'll lend a hand in rebuilding Orison through missions spanning resource gathering, crafting, hauling, and combat.

▲ Where does Orison Relief Support take place?

You can accept the Orison Relief Support missions from anywhere within the Stanton System.

▲ How can I accept the new missions?

Missions can be accepted under the priority tab in the Mission App, and all will start with "Orison Relief". Fourteen new contracts will be available to the citizens of Stanton to help repair the damage to Orison. These include:

Resource Gathering

Collecting and Delivering Medical Supplies

Crafting and Delivering Replacement Platform Thrusters

Taking the Fight Back to the Nine Tails

▲ Can I replay this content?

Absolutely, Orison Relief Support missions are replayable.

▲ When does Orison Relief Support run?

Orison Relief Support will run from now until October 7.

▲ What rewards can I earn?

Every Orison Relief mission you complete builds toward your points total. As that total climbs, you'll unlock set rewards along the way, so the more missions you run, the more you earn.

Rewards you can earn are:

S-38 "SecondWind" Pistol

FBL-8a "SecondWind" Light Armor

P4-AR "SecondWind" Rifle

ORC-mkX "SecondWind" Medium Armor

Lumin V "SecondWind" SMG

ADP-mk4 "SecondWind" Heavy Armor

▲ Where can I see my reward progress?

You can track your progress toward rewards in your Journal in your mobiGlas.

▲ Where can I see the rewards I earn?

Event rewards are attributed directly to your RSI Platform account and are viewable in the My Hangar section of the website. Every contribution to Orison's recovery, and every blow struck against the Nine Tails, will be remembered.

▲ Do I need a specific ship or equipment to participate in Orison Relief Support?

Requirements vary by mission. Some may need specific equipment or take place in hostile environments, while others, like Resource Gathering missions, call specifically for a Salvage ship. Be sure to heed the mission details so you know what to bring, or whether you'll need backup on standby.

title: Updates to Game Access - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all,
body_html:
Hey y'all,

We recently posted about a new Game Library system in the Updates to Pledge Gifting and Game Access, and understandably, many of you had follow-up questions. We’ve rounded up the most common ones below, clarified a few points, and outlined some changes we’ve made thanks to your feedback. We have also created a Knowledge Base Article for these changes.

When does this take effect?

October 1st, 2026. That is the official date. If you have seen October 8th quoted anywhere, it is from a superseded version of the announcement and is not correct.

From October 1st, one pledge per game on your account will automatically be marked as protected. You'll then have until November 1st, 2026, to change which pledge is protected, giving you more control over the selection.

Which pledges on my account will be protected?

To make sure you can never accidentally melt or gift away a game you own, one pledge on your account is designated as the protected Game Access pledge for each game you own: Star Citizen and Squadron 42. A protected pledge cannot be melted or gifted. That is the only change. It stays in your Hangar, and you keep everything in it.

Up to two pledges may be protected, one per game. If a single pledge grants both games, that one pledge protects both. We always protect as few pledges as possible.

The protected pledge is chosen automatically for each game:

If you have a pledge granting that game, which already cannot be melted, such as a High Admiral VIP reward, that pledge is protected. Nothing changes for you.

Otherwise, your oldest pledge granting that game is protected.

Every other pledge remains exactly as meltable and giftable as it is today. The protected pledge will be clearly marked in your Hangar so you can see which pledge is protected and why.

Can I choose which pledge is protected?

Yes. While we initially planned for the system to automatically protect the pledge we felt most backers would prefer, many of you told us you would rather make that choice yourselves. Thanks to your feedback, you’ll be able to change which pledge is protected between October 1st and November 1st, 2026.

You may move protection to any other pledge on your account that grants the same game. Protection is selected per game, so if one pledge currently protects both Star Citizen and Squadron 42, you can move protection for one game to a different pledge and keep the other where it is.

Any pledge granting the game can be selected, including one you buy back or purchase during the window.

The automatically selected pledge is locked from October 1st. It stays locked until you move protection to another pledge. At that moment the new pledge becomes protected and the previous one returns to being meltable and giftable.

You can change your selection as many times as you like during the window.

You make the change from the My Gear page in your Hangar. We will not send a separate reminder before November 1st, so make your choice during the window.

On November 1st, the selection is final and cannot be changed.

A pledge that already cannot be melted or gifted, such as a VIP reward, stays un-meltable regardless. You can still move Game Access protection off it, but there is no advantage in doing so.

I'm a Concierge VIP. Will my oldest game package be locked?

VIP status by itself does not grant game access. The High Admiral VIP reward in your Hangar does. Since March 18th, 2022 that reward includes Star Citizen, and backers who held Squadron 42 before that date also have it in their reward. The reward already cannot be melted or gifted.

Because we always protect an unmeltable pledge first, your VIP reward automatically becomes the protected pledge for any game it includes. Your purchased packages keep their normal melt and gift options.

For a game your VIP reward does not include, the standard rule applies to that game only.

You can still move protection to one of your purchased packages during the window, but there is no advantage in doing so. Your VIP reward can never be melted or gifted anyway, so moving protection only locks a package that would otherwise stay meltable and giftable.

I no longer own a game package. Do I need to buy one before this goes live?

No, provided you still have game access on October 1st, 2026. Your protection is created from whatever grants your access at that moment, including VIP rewards and backer rewards.

One important note: until October 1st, the current rules apply. If you melt or gift the only pledge granting you a game before then, you lose access exactly as you would today. If a pledge is your only source of game access, hold on to it until the protection is in place.

I gifted a pledge that was never claimed. Could it become my protected pledge?

Only if it is your sole source for a game. An unclaimed gift stays in your Hangar and still counts as your game access. We always prefer a pledge you own outright. If a pending gift pledge is the only pledge granting that game, we first cancel the pending gift so it can no longer be claimed, then protect it. If you have another pledge granting that game, we protect that one, and your pending gift stays claimable.

Does a pledge I restore through Buy Back keep its original date?

No. A restored pledge takes the date it was restored, so automatic selection treats it as your newest pledge. Buying back an old starter pack will not cause it to absorb the lock automatically. That said, you can still select the pledge you want to lock. During the change window, you may manually choose a restored pledge as your protected pledge.

Can I still upgrade my protected pledge?

Yes. A protected pledge can be upgraded with CCUs exactly as today. It stays protected, and its contents stay yours.

Do referral rewards, giveaway packs, or subscriber rewards count?

Yes, if they include game access. If such a pledge is the oldest one granting a game, it may be selected. If it is not the one you want protected, you can change the selection during the window.

title: [All Backer] TTK TTD Balance Test Tech-Preview #3
summary: There was an unintended doubling of shield health in this tech-preview compared to the last. This will be fixed for the next test we have with further testing changes
body_html:
There was an unintended doubling of shield health in this tech-preview compared to the last. This will be fixed for the next test we have with further testing changes

Audience: All Backers

Server and Build info: Tech-Preview Channel - US Only servers - 12660092 12689504

Timeframe: Overnight into Friday (end time TBD)

This TTK test will take place throughout the PU and AC

Feedback Thread

https://robertsspaceindustries.com/spectrum/community/SC/forum/4/thread/tech-preview-feedback-ship-ttk-balancing-update-3

Note: We have 1 heavy known issue for this build where ships will skip soft death and blow up at critical 0 instead of disabling.

Thanks to all players who participated in the 2nd Tech Preview and gave us their valuable feedback! Based on this, we are coming to you now with our third iteration on the ship weapon balancing.

But first things first, this is our core takeaway from Tech Preview 2:

Overall the sentiment regarding TP2 was positive

Main criticism in of TP2 addressed the lowered shield health, and the increase of shield absorption - which buffed Ballistic weapons in an unintended manner

Goal to keep the TTK down in the same manner as in TP1 but through different means was only achieved partly. However, the survey showed that the TTK is still considered as too short for small to medium sized ships.

Feedback on the TTK for large and capital ships has been contradicting it was both feedbacked as too low and too high

Lowered Shield Regeneration and Slap down Time was successful

This next Tech Preview now uses TP2 as basis for iteration. Core goals for TP3 are:

Focus on Shield Balancing. This includes the overall direction of combat 2/3 of the fight duration should be spend breaking the shield.

Keep balancing Energy vs Ballistic Weapons

Refining Slap Down times

Increase TTK for PVP, keep low TTK for PVE

Increase TTK of large and capital ships

To Achieve these goals we have made the following changes. If not stated otherwise ALL PREVIOUS CHANGES HAVE BEEN REVERTED.

Major Increase of Shield Health by +134%-212%

Adjustment of Armor Health -30% for small ships, up to +96% for capital ships.

Major Increase of all Alpha Damage by +145%

Armor Deflection for energy damage increased accordingly by +145%

Armor Deflection for ballistic damage increased by +80%

Adjustment of Shield Resistance

► 40-50% For Ballistic Damage depending on shield health and power pip assignment

► 35-45% For Energy Damage depending on shield health and power pip assignment

Adjustment of Shield Absorption

► 0-80% For Ballistic Damage depending on shield health

Slap Down Time increased by

► +100% for when the shield is damaged - same as TP2

► +70% for when the shield is broken - -30% comparted to TP2

Shield Regeneration increased by 95% - keeping the same debuff as in TP2 in relation to other changes. Additionally fixed a bug in which ships with multiple shield faces recharge 4 times quicker than expected.

AI modifier added for PVE. AI ships take +40% Damage.

We are aware that value changes in this TP are extreme. This has a simple reason that we will cover later in this post. First we want to cover the intent of our changes.

Overall time spend fighting shields in comparison amor and critical ship parts should increase

With the adjustments of the Shields Resistance and Absorption, we aim to nerf ballistics again against Energy weapons and give meaning to the power pip assignments of the shields. High assignment in shield power should directly reflect on effectiveness of ballistics

Now to insights into the exact value changes. Generally, as there has been more time between tech previews we were also able to do more internal testing and refining of values, which is why even though values seem odd on paper they played well in the game. Base changes were tested in a controlled Gladius vs Gladius scenario, so we cannot grantee that the results we observed translate identically to all ships, ships sizes, shield size, and weapon sizes. Controlled testing was then followed by testing in uncontrolled PVP and PVE scenarios mimicking how players would perceive our changes.

Extreme value changes as observed in this tech preview is because we are raising all damage and health values to a higher level. Even though we can easily adjust shield and amor health, we unfortunately cannot quickly adjust the HP amount of the critical ship parts due to a lack of tools. If we now take a look at the HP distribution of a ship in TP2, it is apparent that the portion of critical ship parts is too large if the player is supposed to spend only 1/3 of the fight destroying armor and critical parts.

As critical part health cannot be adjusted for now, Armor and especially shield health need to be increased in order to achieve the 2/3 goal. Alpha Damage is increased accordingly to keep TTK low. All other values are adjusted accordingly as well. If TP3 proves to be successful, we will take a look into how we can achieve similar results using more optimal means.

We hope this TP3 will bring you as much fun as we had during testing. We again appreciate your feedback.

Audience: Evocati Only (Standard NDA)

Server Info: PTU Channel - US Only

Long Term Persistence: Enabled

Testing/Feedback Focus

Stability, Bugfixes, LTP between PTU releases

New Event missions in Stanton

Features & Updates

New In-System Event

A new event has arrived in the Stanton system. Head to Stanton and check your mobiGlas contract manager to find the available contracts. The event includes a dedicated mobiGlas tab, a progress tracking UI, a journal entry, and a reward track.

VR Feature Test

VR is now enabled automatically when turned on in the Launcher. Previously it also had to be enabled separately in the in-game menu, which caused confusion

New VR zoom implemented for F-key interaction, precision targeting in ships, and FPS weapon ADS and scopes. A new option, Zoom Gameplay Strength, has been added to reduce the effect or disable it entirely when set to 0. Precision targeting now temporarily snaps the view to the target and significantly reduces look rotation to stabilize the view and reduce nausea

GroundedLook mode now correctly uses the aim vector for hand mining and similar activities

In Freelook mode, tractor beam aiming can now be controlled with head movement, allowing the same speed of use in the ATLS in VR as on desktop

Shield Resistance

Shield resistance values now function correctly when minimum and maximum resistance are set to the same value; previously the restriction that minimum must be lower than maximum caused resistance to be ignored entirely

Abandoned Ship Cleanup

Vehicle lifetime overrides extended to Everus Harbor, Seraphim Station, Bajini Point, and Port Tressler, improving cleanup of abandoned ships at these locations

Character Customizer

Brow dye opacity slider now defaults to 0, matching the behavior of the hair and beard sliders

Alpha Patch 4.10.2 has been released and is now available to test on the PTU environment! Patch should now show: VERSION 4.10.2-PTU.12770507

New Event missions in Stanton

TTK TTD Ship Balance (This is a TECH-PREVIEW within the normal PTU build for the weekend. This is not intended for 4.10.2 but will be a good way to test it!)

Features & Updates

New In-System Event

More balance and polish for the event. Event points are now split across mission types, and mission unlock progression has been rebalanced. Voice comms added across the patrol and support mission flows. Heavy armored enemies encountered during the event now have the correct armament and are appropriately tougher to bring down.

Bug Fixes & Technical

Added new login stability updates. Players should no longer be incorrectly kicked with a "Duplicate Login" error when their client silently reconnects after a dropped connection. Previously a reconnect within a fraction of a second could be mistaken for a second machine and boot the player out of an active game session. This would make it look like you were kicked back to the main menu without explanation.

Potential Fix: Heavy Combat Hunter 3 helmet variants not applying the snoopy cap or necksock when equipped

Potential Fix: MISC Prospector tilting when retrieved from a hangar

Potential Fix: Crafting fabricator filtering the TH-01 Propulsor mission item under "Container" rather than "Missions"

Potential Fix: Event contracts not being available at certain locations around Stanton

Potential Fix: No voice comms playing throughout the event patrol and support mission flows

Potential Fix: Event patrol contracts completing prematurely before all objectives were reached

Potential Fix: Event shelf tag points facing the wrong direction, causing items to be placed incorrectly

Potential Fix: Event NPCs at pickup and dropoff locations standing static instead of moving around the platform

Potential Fix: Event delivery boxes offsetting in the player's hands when picked up from the rear

Potential Fix: Event progress tracker appearing in the mobiGlas Journal before the event was active

Potential Fix: Mirai Pulse and Pulse LX radar UI displaying inverted, with holographic dashboard UI positions adjusted

Potential Fix: Power Config MFD showing no tooltip when hovering over component icons; the tooltip now displays the component name and temperature

Potential Fix: Physicalized storage decals transitioning to a lower LOD too early across multiple vehicles

Potential Fix: RSI Constellation Phoenix piano not playing audio

Potential Fix: Arena Commander Kill Collector FPS players missing the holographic skull head during the Day of the Vara event

Potential Fix: Event salvage contract title containing a typo, and contract titles and descriptions requesting the wrong commodity

TTK Balancing Update Tech-Preivew

For this weekend's PTU build we are folding in the TTK balancing updates! This is just a test for the weekend and is not intended to arrive with 4.10.2 but this will be a great testbed for this!

It’s time for TP4, we hope this time it will go well and also dearest apologies to everyone who participated in TP3, it was cursed. TP3 had multiple serious issues

Due to in issue in implementation, all shields had double their intended health values. This lead to an increased TTK - absolutely opposite to our goal. Props go out to the one player who noticed and commented under our post. There was also a slight issue in communication, we stated that in TP3 our goal is to “Increase TTK for PVP”, thereby we meant to increase it compared to TP2, NOT compared to live.

An error in data entry caused multiple shields to have crazy amounts of power pips causing them to not function in game.

We encountered a new bug that causes ships skip their over damage health pool. This means that instead of being disabled first, ships explode right away - 10 times earlier than they are supposed to. This made ships explode right after their shield is gone.

These issues were addressed mostly in the feedback we received for TP3. Other takeaways were however

Ballistics are still too strong

Even though ships have double the intended shield health, the TTK for large ships decreased.

Power pip assignment cannot be a mean of balancing ballistics at the moment as with current engineering functionality, players tend to max out their shields anyways

The AI Modifier is largely disliked - we have noted this, we are already discussing it

So for TP4 our main objective is to deliver a fixed and refined version of TP3

Shields have been adjusted to intended values, this should bring the TTK down again

Ballistic DMG has been decreased by 20% compared to TP3

AD4B, AD5B, Deadbold IV and Deadbolds V Aplha DMG has been provisionally nerfed by an additional 20% as their they have been called out as OP and impacted feedback

We looked closer into shield and health values of large and capital ships and adjusting their values generally they increased to match them closer to the 2/3 shield, 1/3 Armor and critical parts goal.

Energy and Ballistic Deflection has been adjusted.

AI Modifier has been decreased.

Unfortunately we were not able to fix the over damage bug yet. We currently have a 25-50% reproduction rate. However we still think that intel will be useful. Please keep that in mind during testing.

Overall compared to live we have the following changes - most of them could already be found in TP3

Shield Health +17%- +70%

Armor Health -20% - +100%

Alpha Damage +145% for Energy, +116% for Ballistics

Armor Deflection for Energy increased by +80%, for Ballistics +64%

Adjustment of Shield Resistance

40-50% For Ballistic Damage depending on shield health and power pip assignment

35-45% For Energy Damage depending on shield health and power pip assignment

Adjustment of Shield Absorption

0-80% For Ballistic Damage depending on shield health

Slap Down Time increased by

+100% for when the shield is damaged - same as TP2

+70% for when the shield is broken

Other Updates

Shield Regeneration adjusted according to Health increase. Resulting in slower recharge than Live.

AI modifier added for PVE. AI ships take +20% Damage.

Thanks again for bearing with us on this journey, and we wish you a good time during testing.

Let us know what you think!

title: Re: CIG, when are you going to address the broken life support systems?
summary: Hey folks,
body_html:
Hey folks,

We've actually been tracking this one for some time, indeed, and I recently got an update from the team that I can share with you.

What you're seeing comes down to a difference in how the atmosphere behaves depending on the environment outside the ship.

In a vacuum, when a room is exposed, it loses most of its atmosphere. However, the gas that remains retains its original temperature. Once the room is sealed again, the Life Support system mainly needs to replace the missing atmosphere, which it can do relatively quickly at its default temperature.

On a planet, the situation is a little different. As the room loses its atmosphere, some of it can be replaced by the planet's external atmosphere, which can be extremely cold. Once the room is sealed again, there may already be enough gas inside, but that gas now needs to be heated back up.

At the moment, heating a very cold room requires considerably more from the Life Support system than simply replacing missing atmosphere. The system is still working to bring the temperature back up, but the recovery can take much longer and make it look like it's struggling or overloaded. The team is currently looking at that behavior, so that could mean adjusting the tuning so Life Support can heat cold rooms more effectively, or looking at changes to how atmospheric gases behave when entering a ship from the environment, or even other solutions that we're reviewing.

So, in the end: we’re aware of the issue, we’re tracking it, and our teams are investigating the best solution to address what you’re experiencing. :+1:

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
body_html:
05/10/2026: (Star Citizen 4.10.2)

New: VR now has its own zoom, which works by narrowing the field of view. As this is rather unusual for VR this is meant to be a temporary solution for scopes until we have fully physicalized Scopes.

The view zooms in automatically when your view is aligned to the zoom direction. I eagerly await your feedback to improve and tune it as necessary. It's enabled for:

F Interaction Zooming

ADS / Precision Targeting in ships

FPS weapon scopes

A new Zoom Gameplay Strength option controls how strong the zoom is. Set it lower to reduce the effect, or set it to 0 to turn VR zoom off completely.

Advanced users can use these cvars for a more customized experience:

r_StereoZoomScopeMin (1.0): scopes at or below this magnification don't zoom.

r_StereoZoomHeadTrackingRotationScale (1.0): makes the view turn less than your head while zoomed, to reduce discomfort. 0 turns it off.

r_StereoZoomLockAngle (10): how close (in degrees) your head must point to your aim for the zoom to apply.

r_StereoZoomLockReleaseScale (1.5): extra margin before the zoom releases, so it doesn't flicker.

r_StereoZoomScopeAlignDistance (0.04): how close (in meters) your eye must be to the scope's line of sight.

r_StereoZoomSmoothTime (0.2): how many seconds the zoom takes to ease in and out.

Bug Fixes

Fixed some UI icons disappearing after their spawn animation.

Fixed mouse smoothing and acceleration resetting when switching to VR.

Grounded Look now uses your aim direction for hand mining and similar actions.

In Freelook (Z) when in the ATLS, you can now aim the tractor beam with your head.

title: [4.10.2 Feedback] Physicalized Entity Netcode Overhaul
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

The netcode that governs how loose physics objects behave across the network has been rewritten. Previously the client treated the server's view of an object as either entirely correct or entirely wrong, which meant a single bad state could cascade into persistent desync, rubber-banding, and objects sliding or bouncing for no visible reason.

The new system calculates a trust score for incoming server state rather than applying it unconditionally. Trust is reduced when the client has just done something the server cannot know about yet, such as bumping into a crate, or when the server's state is stale. Corrections are now applied as velocity nudges rather than teleports, and a teleport is only used as a last resort after a sweep check confirms the destination is clear. All tolerances now scale with your current latency and the size of the object rather than using fixed values.

A feedback survey is available at: Physicalized Entity Netcode Overhaul Survey Form. This survey will be open until Oct 31.

We look forward to reading your feedback!

-Shark

Player Experience Team

title: Roadmap Roundup - October 9, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!
body_html:
Hello everyone!

Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.

Just a reminder: The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.

Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.

With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!

-CIG Community Team

Alpha 4.10

RSI Discovery Month Event

Implementing RSI Discovery Month, a limited-time event celebrating the legacy and future of the Constellation, with special RSI installations across Stanton and a variety of Defense, Transport, and Collection missions for players to tackle their way.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Released.

RSI Constellation Series Mk IV Gold Standard

Updating the Constellation series Mk IV to Gold Standard, with improvements including updated art, gameplay updates, physicalized components, improved cockpit visibility, a refreshed HUD, and more.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Released.

RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus

Implementing the RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus, a convention-defying ship that takes on cargo, combat, and more. This multi-role, multi-crew ship brings RSI’s legacy of experience to the next generation with this impressive evolution of one of its most beloved and iconic ships.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Released.

RSI Skylark

Implementing the RSI Skylark, a snub fighter nestled within the Constellation’s reimagined hull.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Released.

Alpha 4.11

DGS Planet Subdivision

Implementing a tech that allows us to subdivide planets and moons into smaller territories, so a single Dynamic Game Server (DGS) is never responsible for an entire body. Territory boundaries are generated from spatial clustering of seeded entities scattered by Genesis, and dynamically assigned to available DGSs, improving load distribution and paving the way for finer‑grained server meshing at planetary scale. Nyx 1 will be the first planet to use this tech.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Tentative.

Nyx I

Nyx I is a coreless planet that orbits closest to the sun in the Nyx system. Once considered impossible to terraform, Nyx I has undergone a drastic transformation thanks to new experimental technology developed by Genesis Terraforming and now features a robust ecosphere capable of supporting a wide diversity of life.

:scroll: This card has been updated with a new image.

Nyx II

With high temperatures and a high-pressure atmosphere dense with thick clouds, Nyx II is an inhospitable planet where protective gear is recommended. While some resources dot the surface, the risk involved in harvesting them has left the planet almost void of commercial development.

:scroll: This card has been updated with a new image.

Nyx III

Nyx III is an ice giant that lacks a breathable atmosphere and is considered a difficult candidate for expansive commercial resource extraction.

Today, we are releasing the RSI Launcher 2.18.1

RSI Launcher can be found here:

:gear: New features:

What's new in this release:

Reworked the installer so each download and patching step runs in its own isolated process. This is fixing 5009 install errors and "file in use" failures on cancel

We updated the max number of guides displayed on the Guide System to 999.

Access to main org and referral code from the account panel

RSI is celebrating the arrival of the next-generation Constellation, the new Mk V Centaurus, and all pilots across Stanton are invited to join in. This is a question you have to answer for yourself, as it depends on a few factors:

- Are you just going to play Star Citizen or any other games?

- Do you prefer a wireless or wired Headset?

- Is OLED Important to you (true blacks)

- Comfort?

- What is your budget? What GPU do you have?

If you have a Quest 2 any modern headset right now will be a serious improvement, even if it just a Quest 3.

The perfect headset in my mind would still be a OLED Steam Frame with high resolutions. Still praying we get that one day. I know there are rumours, but I don't expect it any time soon.

Overall the Steam Frame runs and works well with Star Citizen, but visually it is not better as the Quest 3, maybe even slightly worse. It is much more comfortable than the Quest 3 and everything just works.

If you have a capable GPU and the budget Dream Air is the best you can get right now. Also very comfortable and visually seriously impressive.

Ghostly greetings, y'all!

Shadows are stretching longer, and there's a chill creeping into the air, which can only mean one thing: Day of the Vara is here, and it's time to dust off the carving knives. We're bringing back one of our favorite community traditions: the Pumpkin Decorating Contest!

Grab a pumpkin, your carving knife, your paintbrush, or whatever else you've got in the toolshed, and turn your gourd into the spookiest creation this side of the 'verse. This year, we're leaning into some classic monster themes: Frankenstein, Vampire, and Werewolf. As a treat and not a trick, every qualified entry earns "The Hill Horror" Helmet that's permanently attributed to your account, one per account. So pick your poison and show us what you've got for a shot at some devilishly good prizes.

Welcome to the '2026 Pumpkin Decorating Contest!

Before You Begin

:exclamation:Before you start on your submissions, please read the contest rules carefully and remember to post your entries to the Day of the Vara 2956 event page on the Community Hub. Replies to this thread will NOT count as entries.:exclamation:

Keep In Mind

Read the contest rules! :book:

Your pumpkin must fit one of the three monster themes: Frankenstein, Vampire, or Werewolf. Bonus points for weaving in Star Citizen: ship silhouettes, faction logos, alien flavor, scenes from the 'verse. The more SC flavor, the better your shot at winning, but a solid monster pumpkin on its own still counts.

Your submission must also include at least one photo or video that shows your process. Your submission will NOT be accepted without this.

Only real pumpkins, carved and/or painted, will be accepted

Submit your posts carefully, as posts edited after the submission deadline will not be considered. If you have made an error in the post, you can edit it provided this is done within the official duration of the contest.

Please post your submissions to the Day of the Vara 2956 event page on the Community Hub.

Each unique pumpkin is considered a single entry, and you are allowed multiple entries, but you can only win 1 prize.

No image post-processing, special or after-effects of any kind may be applied or performed on the photograph to create any submission, although the pumpkin may be photographed with decoration, arrangement, or lighting.

Submissions that use or feature AI will NOT be considered.

Any submission not following the above instructions will NOT be considered.

Any submission that meets the above requirements will be awarded "The Hill Horror" Helmet to be attributed after the contest ends.

Winning Conditions

The CIG jury will judge your submissions on:

Quality: Clean carving or paint work that holds up in a photo. A Frankenstein stitched together with sloppy cuts and slapped-on paint won't score as well as one built with real care.

Creativity: A carved Werewolf could just be a wolf face. An SC spin might have it howling at a Crusader moon. Both qualify. The second just scores higher.

Rule adherence: Even the scariest Vampire won't score if it skips the contest requirements. Read the rules, follow them, and you're covered.

Dates

The submission period will end on Monday, November 9, 2026, 20:00 UTC.

Prizes

One winner from each theme/category will receive their choice of one of three ships with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + accompanying paint + one mask bundle. These prizes are non-giftable and non-upgradable.

Drake Vulture in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Frankenstein paint + Mask bundle.

Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Werewolf paint + Mask bundle.

Aegis Eclipse in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Vampire paint + Mask bundle.

Time to squash the competition with your spooktacular handiwork; we can't wait to see what you come up with! :jack_o_lantern:

Intersec Defence Solutions has opened a new contract line against the Vanduul and the Shattered Blade clan. [redacted] Takedown (Rank 4 to 6): Fight through waves of Vanduul until a [redacted] is drawn to the incursion site, across five difficulty tiers

New space and FPS combat points of interest placed throughout the Nyx system

A second cryopod variant has been introduced. The existing red pods hold living Vanduul, while the new tint marks a dead one. Dead pods are the more valuable of the two and can be traded to Wikelo

Rewards

New FPS Weapon: LBCO Skarnov Rifle

Weight: Average

Fire modes: Fully automatic / Single

Damage: 27

Projectile Velocity: 500

Aim down Sight Time: 0.25

RPM: 375

Mag size: 30

Electrical Jump Range - 5M

Max Jump range 3m

Design Notes from Zac

It's been a while since the Lightning Bolt Co. has unleashed a weapon onto the verse but with this new fully automatic DMR, they're here to make an impression.

The Skarnov rifle, like the other LBCO weapons leaves the target with an electrified pulse that denotates and chains to other nearby targets causing devastation for enemies in tight proximity.

It's got a really consistent but high vertical recoil profile allowing skills operators to shut down highly armoured enemies easily but as an energy weapon the danger of over heating is present.

The skarnov is effected by the atmospheric temperatures its used in, causing hot environments to cause overheat faster and colder environments to build up heat slower.

One more thing is that whenever we do weapons, It's been requested that for the PTU we make weapons easier to use in the verse for feedback. For PTU phases, the weapon and ammo can be found in the following locations:

Area18 - Cubby Blast

GrimHex - Skutters

Levski - Conscientious Objects

Checkmate - Weapon Shop

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hello Citizens, a few tweaks and fixes have been made to the new zoom for the latest patch.
body_html:
Hello Citizens, a few tweaks and fixes have been made to the new zoom for the latest patch.

Alpha 4.10.3: VR Updates (EDIT: Will come with the next patch)

- Third-person cameras no longer zoom the VR view when the gameplay FOV changes. Ship ADS no longer zooms the ship's third-person view.

- Added scope eye relief. While a scope zooms the VR view, the view now moves back along the scope so more of the magnified image stays visible. The pull-back scales with scope zoom up to a maximum (none at 1x, 9 cm at 4x, 15 cm at 6x and above). It adjusts smoothly when you switch zoom levels and fades in and out with the zoom. Vehicle ADS and Interaction Mode zooms are unaffected.

- Split the VR zoom strength setting into separate Scope Zoom Strength and Ship Zoom Strength sliders. These replace the previous Gameplay Zoom Strength setting. The zoom strength settings no longer affect the Interaction Mode zoom.

- Default tuning changes: minimum scope zoom raised from 1.0 to 1.6, scope align distance raised from 0.04 to 0.05, and zoom smoothing shortened from 0.2 to 0.15 for snappier transitions.

- Medbeds now default your VR view to looking up instead of forward at your body, which makes the screen easier to use without breaking your neck!

- Fixed texture banding on the scope projection texture.

- Fixed several crashes with the experimental VR depth composition option (r_StereoDepthComposition). Note that this is disabled by default and need to be explicitly enabled via console or user.cfg. Once enabled it keeps its value over subsequent runs.

title: Updates to Pledge Gifting - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all
body_html:
Hey y'all

Since the recent announcement about Updates to Pledge Gifting and Game Access, we’ve received a number of questions from the community. Much like in our previous Updates to Game Access - FAQ, we’ve gathered some of your most common questions below and clarified the details where needed.

When does this take effect?

The updates to gifting will take effect on October 30.

Can I gift anything?

Only items where the "Buying as a gift?" option appears at checkout.

How will the updated gifting process work?

When an item is gifted, the recipient will receive an email with a redemption code. They can select the redemption link (the code is filled in) or go to the Redemption Page and enter the code to claim their gift.

Does the recipient need an RSI account?

Yes. They’ll need an RSI account with a confirmed email address to claim the gift. An account can be created after receiving the gift email, before claiming the gift.

Can I gift an item if I am not signed in?

No. You must be signed in to gift or claim an item.

Can I pay for a gift with store credit?

No. Store credit can't be used on a gift order.

Will the gift appear in my Hangar before sending the gift?

No. The gift is emailed to the recipient after the transaction is completed and is added to the recipient's hangar when they claim it.

Do I get badges, perks, or referral credit for something I gifted?

The badges and perks go to the recipient who claims the gift. Referral credit for the purchase stays with the buyer.

How does the 30-day refund period work for a pledge designated as a gift?

If the gift isn't claimed after 30 days, the buyer is refunded automatically and notified by email.

What happens to existing hangar gifts?

Existing hangar gifts and gift codes are grandfathered in and will continue working just as they do today, with the same Redemption Page available to redeem them.

Do I have to give the gift right away or can I wait to send it to the recipient?

Gifts are sent automatically once the transaction is complete and cannot be scheduled for a later date.

The orange/yellow notification usually means Spectrum has been updated, with bug fixes, new features, or other improvements. The red notification (error toast) can appear for several reasons. For example, a firewall may have blocked your action, or rate limiting may apply when too many requests are sent at once. title: RSI Launcher 2.19.2 Release Notes
summary: Hello everyone,
body_html:
Hello everyone,

Today, November 9th, we are releasing the RSI Launcher 2.19.2.

RSI Launcher can be found here:

https://install.robertsspaceindustries.com/rel/2/RSI%20Launcher-Setup-2.19.2.exe

This Thread was updated from Launcher 2.19.1 to 2.19.2 on November 9th. There is no major update in content, but a backend QOL fix.

In this version, we’ve updated the display of the download process to better indicate the status of the download phases and how many remain.

We’ve also added a shader compiling stage, so that this task can be done before entering the game.

The shader compiling feature is only fully working with game version 4.10.3 and up. Until then the game might still complie shaders while getting in the game.

:gear: New features:

What's new in this release:

New downloads panel: the header popover now shows the ongoing installation (version/channel, step-by-step progress, pause/resume/cancel, network, disk, CPU and memory usage).

The game page also shows a compact step row and progress bar under the game button.

Shader compilation (optional step): at the end of an install or update, the game can now compile its shader cache before entering the game. You can launch the game at any time, or choose “Skip shader compilation”: the install completes and the game finishes its shaders on the next launch.

New Settings for deleting and compiling shaders from the games settings.

The compiling phase can take from 7 to 30+ min depending on your computer.

Updated data patcher for data generations: smoother progress reporting, a verification pass that repeats until the files are clean, more detailed error information, and a dedicated dialog when the disk fills up during a download.

Guide System: Presence status in the account panel and in the guide session is in sync with the web

:wrench: Fixed Issues:

Downloads panel only redraws the values that change, reducing UI load during installs.

Fixed the Launcher muting and minimizing before showing the “already running” message on a double click launch.

:bug: Known issues:

If you witness a black rectangle on the bottom right of your screen, please turn off the overlay notification in your notification settings.

Some users encounter a flickering Launcher background, which can be partially mitigated by turning off accessibility settings. Please refer to this comment for a potential fix: https://robertsspaceindustries.com/spectrum/community/SC/forum/1/thread/rsi-launcher-2-0-6-release-notes/7279512

The Launcher sometimes fails to create the StarCitizen/Live folders for some users, leading to Error 2000, Error 5008, or Error 5010. Try creating the folder manually and running the Launcher as an administrator.

LCH-1030: Launcher suppresses Screen Saver.

LCH-1958: Never Ending Download loop. Please report the issue; we're having trouble reproducing it.

Users might encounter Desync with Language and Proficiencies while using the guide system both on Spectrum and in the Launcher at the same time.

For game version lower than 4.10.3 complile shader might be run a second time when getting in the game. This is fixed for game version 4.10.3 and up.

Please try this version and share your feedback with us! Your feedback is essential for improving the Launcher.

:mega: RSI Issue Council - Launcher Project

https://issue-council.robertsspaceindustries.com/projects/LAUNCHER

Any additional feedback can be provided in this Spectrum Thread.

Since RSI launcher 2.0.0, the log.log file can be found by clicking on “GET LOGS” in application settings or under: C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Roaming\rsirclauncher\logs.
