title: Roadmap Roundup - November 4, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!
body_html:
Hello everyone!

Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.

Just a reminder: The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.

Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.

-CIG Community Team

Notable Changes: November 4, 2026

With today's Roadmap Update, we're officially renaming Alpha 4.11 to Alpha 5.0, reflecting the significance of the new technologies and features coming together in this release.

At the heart of Alpha 5.0 are several foundational technologies from Genesis, our initiative to transform how we create, populate, and bring planetary environments to life.

Starchitect introduces a procedural world-building system that uses Genesis data to distribute locations across planetary surfaces and assemble them from modular components, allowing our teams to expand the universe at scale.

Planet Tech V5 overhauls how planets are generated and rendered, introducing more natural biomes, improved vegetation and rock distribution, enhanced terrain materials, and GPU-driven generation for richer environments and improved performance.

Population Manager introduces new systems for balancing server populations and populating environments with inhabitants suited to their surroundings, laying the groundwork for more dynamic interactions.

Contract Boards bring mission opportunities directly into the world. Guild Halls at regional hubs allow players to browse contracts, complete assignments, and build reputation with different guilds, while Contract Boards offer faction and guild missions at local, regional, global, and solar system levels. Featuring a brand-new interface with improved contract information and faction-based browsing, Contract Boards support our broader vision for Hub and Spoke gameplay.

DGS Planet Subdivision advances server meshing by dividing planets and moons into smaller, dynamically assigned server territories, rather than relying on a single server for an entire planetary body.

Nyx I will be the first planet to feature these technologies, with plans to expand them to Nyx II, Nyx III, and other existing locations and planets throughout the 'verse.

Together, these additions lay the foundation for more detailed environments, more dynamic planetary populations, and a universe that continues to grow in both scale and complexity.

We can't wait for you to explore Nyx I and experience what's coming in Alpha 5.0. With that, let's dive into this week's Roadmap Roundup!

Release View

Alpha 4.10

Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR (4.10.3)

⁠Implementing the Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR, a fully automatic designated marksman rifle whose specialized projectiles create electrical discharges between multiple targets, making it highly effective against groups of hostiles.

:scroll: This card is moving forward from 5.0, to release earlier in 4.10, and set to Committed.

Alpha 5.0

Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements

Implementing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements, updating ship and item recovery to better support custom loadouts through timed claims, optional expedite fees, freight elevator item claims, and debuting a free recovery option when losses are detected as outside the player’s control.

:scroll: This Tentative card requires additional work and has been removed from the Release View for now.

Contract Boards

Implementing Contract Boards as a new way to discover and accept faction and guild missions at local, regional, global, and solar system levels through Guild Halls and hubs across the 'verse, featuring a brand-new interface that makes browsing contracts and filtering by faction easier and more intuitive.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Committed.

S3 & S10 Bomb Racks

Implementing Size 10 and Size 3 bomb racks at shops in the PU, expanding support for different bomb sizes and loadout configurations.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Committed.

Loot Refresh

Rebalancing loot at various sandbox locations and introducing previously Wikelo-exclusive rewards to the loot pool.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Tentative.

Vehicle Combat Balance Pass

Implementing a weapon balancing pass for ship combat, with a focus on fighter combat and adjustments to weapon performance, time to kill, and the balance between energy and ballistic weapons.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Tentative.

Kastak Arms "Hellion" Pistol

Implementing the Hellion Plasma Pistol, a high-velocity plasma weapon that creates hazardous impact zones, allowing operators to rapidly deploy multiple areas of denial across the battlefield.

:scroll: This card has been set to Committed.

Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG

Implementing the Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG, a medium-range weapon that builds heat through sustained fire before unleashing devastating superheated plasma projectiles with its alternate fire mode.

:scroll: This card has been set to Committed.

Alpha 5.1

Nyx II and Nyx III

:scroll: Previously targeting Alpha 5.0, these are now tentatively scheduled for Alpha 5.1.

title: [5.0 PTU Feedback] Starchitect POIs
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

Nyx I has been populated with points of interest (POIs) using the Starchitect tool, which is a new technology that dynamically scatters content across a planetary scale to flesh out an entire world with places to explore. This pre-export tool is used by designers to generate the following hierarchy of items:

Nyx I (Planet) > Sectors (Like a country) > Clusters (Like a region) > Locations (A POI) > Tiles (Buildings, OC’s etc).

Each part of this hierarchy has been given their own properties, data and rules to define their identity, allowing us to make sure that every part of the planet feels unique. Every cluster in a sector has a singular Hub location which is visible on the Starmap, along with it’s amenities. The rest is found by exploration or by engaging in contracts.

A feedback survey is available at: Starchitect POIs Survey Form. This survey will be open until Nov 30.

Thank you for taking the time, and we look forward to reading your feedback!

-Shark

Player Experience Team

title: [5.0 PTU Feedback] Intraplanetary Server Meshing
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

Today's Tech Preview takes the server meshing of Nyx I one step further. Nyx 1 uses the same Quasi-Dynamic Server Meshing (QDSM) algorithms introduced in 4.10 (to load-balance the many SoO instances onto different servers), to distribute Nyx I’s many many clusters onto different servers. This latest approach works with much smaller units and can therefore load balance more finely, putting more clusters on colder servers, and fewer clusters on hotter ones.

A feedback survey is available at: Intraplanetary Server Meshing Survey Form. This survey will be open until Nov 30.

Thank you for taking the time, and we look forward to reading your feedback!

summary: Greetings!

Greetings!

Nyx 1 has been built using the new Genesis planetary technology and is ready for you to help test. Biomes now blend seamlessly across the surface rather than transitioning at hard boundaries, and can be discovered naturally by flying, driving, or walking across the planet. New GPU-based scattering system drives vegetation and geology placement across the surface. Nyx 1 will include many biome types including grassy plains, forests, swamps, wetlands, beaches, mountains and deserts.

Feedback Focus

• Do biome transitions feel natural as you move between them?

Traversal

• Do ground vehicles handle the new terrain surfaces as expected?

Performance data is a priority for this test. When reporting performance issues, please include:

• The biome you were in when the issue occurred

• Whether you were on foot or in a vehicle

• Your full system specs

• Your graphics settings and resolution

A feedback survey is available at: Planet Tech V5 Survey Form. This survey will be open until Nov 30.

title: [Now Closed] Star Citizen Alpha 5.0 PTU 13119881 - Genesis, QDSM, Starchitect, Mission Boards
summary: Build: 13119881 - PTU Channel
body_html:
Build: 13119881 - PTU Channel

Wave 1 testers

Timeframe for test: Overnight until 2pm Central 20:00 UTC Friday

Welcome to the first 5.0 PTU! Across our recent Tech Previews we brought new location archetypes to Nyx I, introduced Intraplanetary Server Meshing, and added the Procedural Generation Tracker so that mineables, harvestables and fauna could run across the mesh. With this build we move into PTU proper. The focus this time is the planet itself: Nyx I has had a substantial environment pass covering biomes, flora placement, weather and lighting, alongside new guild halls with mission boards and another round of contract work.

Nyx I Environment Pass

The surface of Nyx I has had a broad polish pass this cycle, concentrating on how the biomes read at both close range and distance. Flora placement rules have been tightened so species no longer appear on ground types they have no business growing in, and the color work has been reconciled between near and far viewing distances so a forest looks the same whether you are standing in it or flying over it. We have also reworked how rock surfaces and medium terrain layers render, which should give geology considerably more depth than it had previously.

Forest density updated, with Heart of Woods now spawning in different locations

Gutierrezia and green Heart of Woods no longer spawn on beach soil, matching the other land plants

Mature Populus now receives random yaw and tilt instead of a fixed orientation

Summer foliage darkened, with far-distance color tuning to match close-up color

Lemna seasonal offset corrected so near and far colors agree

Snow biome accumulation now uses the same surface grouping as the other biomes

Clay and granite colors corrected, having previously been derived from the wrong color space

Rock shading classes now support parallax occlusion mapping, with height reworked to suit

Medium terrain layers now scaled for maximum precision against texture range

Bush shading class tweaks, and new shading classes for Nyx I

The environment team updated rock and environmental assets with explicit wheeled collision behavior setup per sub-asset following a drivability review

Several Nyx I rock variants now ignore wheeled vehicles entirely

Dalbergia physical collision restored after being lost in an earlier change

Potential Fix: Ground cover floating above the terrain, which now takes the lower of bedrock displacement and soil (STARC-221075)

Weather and Atmosphere

Atmospheric lighting has been reworked so that sky illumination responds to actual cloud cover rather than cloud type. Overcast skies now carry the light that genuinely scatters through a thick layer, which means brighter conditions beneath heavy cloud and a noticeably brighter night sky when it is overcast. Rain, lightning and the day-night temperature range now all follow real coverage too, and the snow effects have been retuned for the elevations Nyx I actually has.

Ground storm snow effects reworked, with the elevation ruleset changed so the main effects appear at the higher altitudes needed for Nyx I

Rain no longer accumulates below the snow line

Lightning strength calculation reworked, separating event location weighting from event strength

Lightning strikes are now more likely in lower density cloud clusters

Potential Fix: Lightning strikes culling too quickly on planets, with spawn shapes now sized to the targeting mode and strike frequency recalculated on each attempt

Planet audio queries now batch surface data lookups

Nyx I color grades and far-distance lookup tables updated

Guild Halls and Mission Boards

Guild halls have arrived on Nyx I, giving each guild a physical presence on the planet where contracts can be picked up from mission boards. Alongside these, the wider location kit has had an art and lighting pass, and loot distribution across settlements has been rebalanced following director feedback.

Guild hall walls, colors and room tinting reworked, with mesh pieces swapped to give logos breathing room and gloss reduced

Guild hall screen materials and cover window geometry added

Mission board and notice board backdrops added

Command and bridge buildings reworked, including floor heights, ceiling heights and visarea cleanup

New depot, campsite and bunker tiles, with loot added throughout

Loot quantity and quality increased in locked command building rooms

Sniper weapon racks and ammunition loot boxes added to watchtowers, with more ammunition caches across compound tiles

Logistics exterior cladding, wall kits and window frames refined

Watchtower and storage exterior fixes, plus a new vent prefab

Climbable ledges added across depot tiles, agriculture tiles and extractor sites

Placeholder ladders replaced with finished prefabs

Irrigator and extractor visual effects added

Lighting passes across habitation, storage, depot, agriculture, extraction, maintenance and watchtower tiles

Defensive turret health increased by 50% at sizes 1 through 3

Mining extractor kill volumes set up

Level 3 keycard NPCs removed from all combatant class pools except First Legion

Potential Fix: Shelf top item ports taking 1 SCU containers where they should take two-handed items

Potential Fix: Missing ceiling in an exterior alcove, inner railings around AA turrets, a replace-me decal, and a misaligned door interaction point

Contracts

Contract work continues across the guilds, with the Covalex sets coming online this cycle alongside campsite and missing person work. A number of generation and spawning problems that blocked contracts in the last preview have also been addressed.

Covalex contracts enabled, with a first pass on reward balance

Campsite contracts enabled, including the Hockrow missing person campsite

Eckhart Global contract fixes

Missing person mission hooks restored

Ship graveyard mission locations added around Nyx I

Contract titles and descriptions updated across the Nyx I set

Eliminate and Destroy contracts now share a resource slot with interior Eliminate Specifics

Espionage and diagnostics data disks are no longer stackable

Potential Fix: Red Wind lost shipment recovery contracts not appearing in game

Potential Fix: Eckhart Security target AI not spawning

Potential Fix: Missing person corpse not spawning

Potential Fix: Harvestable mission items being rejected by freight elevators

Potential Fix: Contracts requiring too many resource slots across multiple phases

Potential Fix: Eliminate All objectives at multi-location contracts

Potential Fix: Server rack entity tags for destroy server contracts

Potential Fix: “Opening” text wrapping incorrectly

Intraplanetary Server Meshing

Following the introduction of Intraplanetary Server Meshing and the Procedural Generation Tracker in the Tech Previews, this build focuses on the spatial systems underneath it. The entity tracking structures that decide what gets streamed, replicated and simulated have been substantially reworked for planetary scale, and the declaration ceiling for location entities has been raised to cope with the density of procedural surface content.

Spatial partitioning rework across entity streaming, the aggregate manager and network replication

Maximum location entity declarations raised to 256

Fleet service can now mark an unhealthy instance, and provisioned mesh instances can be queried directly

AI can once again use cover on planetary surfaces

Potential Fix: Party member connection notifications firing whenever a party member changed server authority after a crash recovery

Potential Fix: Navigation mesh generation between terrain patches

Potential Fix: External navigation link issues

Potential Fix: Dynamic objects failing to stream in their surroundings due to instance culling

Bug Fixes & Technical

Fixed 9 client crashes and 1 server crash

Potential Fix: Players losing collision with their own ship after leaving a seat, leaving ramps and elevators non-solid (STARC-201214)

Potential Fix: Items being lost after being carried (STARC-221212)

Potential Fix: Ground vehicles and powersuits not being recoverable through insurance claims

Potential Fix: Delivery item ports deleting mission items placed on the wrong port

Potential Fix: Only one PvP law enforcement contract being offered at a time

Potential Fix: Control terminals in Arena Commander Control not being interactable

Potential Fix: Female Levski guards displaying placeholder textures

Potential Fix: ASOP terminal sound effects

High Risk bounty contracts now award 4,000 reputation rather than 2,000 (STARC-114590)

Every year, we strap in for two weeks of excitement as pilots from across the ‘verse travel to Stanton for the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo (IAE), the biggest annual ship show in Star Citizen. title: IAE 2956 - Choose Your Adventure - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all,
body_html:
Hey y'all,

It’s time again for the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo 2956 to bring together the best that Human and Alien ingenuity has to offer in the ultimate ship showcase! To make sure you don’t miss out, we’ve pulled together answers to the questions we hear most.

What is the IAE?

The Intergalactic Aerospace Exposition (IAE) is the universe's premier aerospace expo. It's where everyone can see some of Star Citizen's most legendary ships and ground vehicles up close as different manufacturers showcase their latest and greatest in the expo center halls. More than 200 ships and ground vehicles are yours to test-fly for free! Whether you're a seasoned pilot or just starting your journey, this is your chance to take the helm of the universe's most iconic rides.

When is IAE taking place?

IAE runs from November 13 at 16:00 UTC through November 27.

When does the Free Fly start?

The Free Fly will start on November 13, simultaneously with the launch of IAE.

I don't have a Star Citizen game package or in-game spacecraft. How do I travel to New Babbage for the event?

For the duration of the IAE, every account has access to an RSI Aurora Mk II. After getting started, head to the nearest ASOP ship retrieval terminal to access it.

Where does the IAE take place? Where do I have to go?

IAE is being held at the Tobin Expo Center in New Babbage, the largest city on microTech.

How do I get to the Tobin Expo Center?

Start off by heading to microTech. After you create your character, you'll be asked where to start. Pick the Stanton system, then New Babbage as your primary residence, and your journey to the expo begins. Once there, follow the signs, hop on the Metroloop, and you’ll be in ship heaven in no time.

If you’re coming from off-planet, New Babbage’s spaceport is microTech’s main travel hub. Land there and follow the IAE signs for easy transport to the expo.

What ships are available to fly for free?

Each day of the IAE, there will be different ships available for you to test-fly. Check out the full Manufacturer Schedule for details.

How do I rent a ship?

In the expo center halls, you'll find ships on display from a variety of manufacturers throughout the event. If something catches your eye, head over to the Traveler Rentals terminals in the main IAE hall during that vehicle’s Manufacturer Day and follow the on-screen prompts to take it for a spin.

In addition to the ships on the show floor, each Manufacturer Day also unlocks a wider selection of flyable ships, some of which aren't on display but are still available to rent through the terminals. Manufacturers cycle almost every day, so be sure to check back often! You can visit the full schedule to plan your test flights.

You can then head to the spaceport or any other ASOP terminal throughout the 'verse.

How long can ships be rented?

Once you have rented a ship or vehicle, it will be available for 48 hours.

How many vehicles can be rented?

You can rent every flyable or drivable vehicle exhibited at the IAE, and some that aren’t exhibited, too. Each ship or vehicle can be rented once.

Which ships get the Best in Show paints?

All four ships that made it into the semi-finals of the recent Ship Showdown event (RSI Perseus, Origin M80, Drake Corsair, Drake Ironclad Assault) will receive the limited-edition Best in Show livery as well as a manufacturer-themed coin and coin case. These are available to all players with these ships in their hangars. Additionally, the Perseus will receive a collectible manufacturer-themed bomber jacket to commemorate the glory of being this year's Ship Showdown champion.

If you already have one of these ships, you'll receive the IAE-exclusive paint (and extra items) following the last day of the event at no cost. To be eligible to receive the paints, the specific Best in Show ships, and not variants, need to be active in your web-hangar at the end of IAE (having them in your Buyback List won't grant you the Best in Show paints). If you melt any of the ships before receiving the associated paints, then you will no longer be eligible.

Everyone pledging for a Best in Show (BIS) ship during the IAE will also receive the paint and items. If you don't already have the ship, it will be offered as part of a bundle with the prizes on Best in Show day.

Please note that these Best in Show Edition bundles already include the BIS paints, coin, and coin case, and will not grant the standalone versions of those items.

The Best in Show ships will also be available to fly for free between November 22 and November 27.

Will there be Warbond Daily Deals available?

Yes! Check back each day throughout the event to see what's available. Each Warbond Daily Deal will run for 24 hours only.

Will there be quantity stock-limited ships?

Yes! Each stock-limited ship is limited to one per account and will be available in six waves to cover as many global time zones as possible. Please note that depending on your time zone, some waves may occur the next calendar day.

▲ Wave 1 - 16:00 UTC

▲ Wave 2 - 20:00 UTC

▲ Wave 3 - 00:00 UTC

▲ Wave 4 - 04:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 5 - 08:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 6 - 12:00 UTC (the following day)

► Starting on November 14 (IAE Day 2): Origin 890 Jump

► Starting on November 17 (IAE Day 5): Drake Kraken, Drake Kraken Privateer

► Starting on November 18 (IAE Day 6): Consolidated Outland Pioneer

► Starting on November 20 (IAE Day 8): Aegis Idris-P, Aegis Javelin

Is there anything else that's new this IAE?

The price of the MISC Prospector will increase by $20, from $155 to $175 on MISC Day of IAE.

Until then, the Prospector will remain at $155. If you’ve been considering adding one to your fleet, there’s still time to get it before the change takes effect.

Do I need a copy of Star Citizen to enjoy the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo?

No. For the duration of the event, anyone can play Star Citizen for free. All you need to do is visit the Play Now page and follow the instructions.

Can I invite a friend?

Of course! All they need to do is visit the Play Now page, create an account, and jump into the game. Don't forget, using your referral code during account creation grants them an additional 50,000 UEC. And if they decide to stay after the Free Fly, you'll earn a referral point.

I am a new player. Where do I get more info?

The Welcome Hub is a fantastic first stop with a plethora of tips on how to get started and various tutorials to help you get off on the right foot navigating the 'verse. Star Citizen veterans act as informal guides for an ever-growing number of new players in the Guide System. The Knowledge Base answers the most frequent questions in articles that cover everything from how to create an account to character equipment.

Will there be more Twitch Drops?

Yes. Twitch Drops are returning for IAE. Watch any Drops-enabled Star Citizen stream for two hours to unlock the Venture Undersuit Black/Grey, four hours to add the matching Venture Black Armor Set, and six hours to complete the set with a MacFlex Backpack Orange.
